papers.title: Performance of T-beam bridge decks with fatigue deterioration subjected to TNT equivalent BLEVE loads
papers.abstract: During the service life, bridges are subjected to long-term fatigue loads induced by heavy-duty vehicles, while simultaneously facing the threat of accidental explosions resulting from warfare, improper transportation of hazardous materials, or traffic accidents. It is widely known that fatigue causes material damage and degradation of structural performance. Unfortunately, the accumulated fatigue damage has not been considered for estimating the dynamic behaviour of the bridge deck. This study proposes a numerical method to evaluate the blast resistance of T-beam bridge decks with fatigue damage subjected to boiling liquid expanding vapour explosion (BLEVE) loads by the TNT equivalent method. First, the finite element models of T-beam bridge decks are established to analyse the influence of fatigue on their blast performance. The results indicate that fatigue significantly weakens the blast resistance of the T-beam bridge decks (with the mid-span displacement increasing by up to 2 times). This phenomenon is mainly attributed to the differences in the energy dissipation mechanisms. Second, parametric analysis indicates that TNT equivalence is the most sensitive parameter, with an amplification effect of up to 1.8 times. Finally, based on machine learning techniques optimised via 5-fold cross-validation and Bayesian hyperparameter optimisation, a predictive model for the maximum displacement of fatigue-damaged T-beam bridge decks under blast loading is established. This study provides a reliable and efficient approach for the damage assessment of long-term service bridges under blast loading.
papers.summary: 该研究关注长期服役桥梁累积疲劳损伤后遭遇偶然爆炸的抗爆表现。作者以TNT当量法表征沸腾液体膨胀蒸气爆炸荷载，建立T梁桥面板有限元模型，并开展参数分析与机器学习位移预测。摘要报告疲劳削弱抗爆能力，将响应差异主要归因于耗能机制，并指出TNT当量是最敏感参数。解读：研究将服役劣化与突发荷载联合考虑，对既有桥梁风险评估具有参考价值；但摘要不足以核验模型验证及预测精度。[摘要]

article.lead: 长期车辆荷载造成的疲劳损伤，会怎样改变桥面板面对偶发爆炸时的表现？这项研究将疲劳退化、爆炸响应与机器学习预测联系起来，为理解在役T梁桥面板的抗爆评估提供了一个数值研究视角。

sections.title: 爆炸来临前，桥面板已承受长期疲劳
paragraphs: 桥梁服役期间持续承受重型车辆引起的疲劳荷载，也可能面临危险品运输不当、交通事故或战争造成的爆炸威胁。疲劳会导致材料损伤与结构性能退化，因此，评估爆炸响应时，桥面板此前积累的损伤状态值得关注。
摘要将累积疲劳损伤在桥面板动力行为估计中的考虑不足作为研究切入点。本文关注的不是单独的疲劳寿命，而是已经发生疲劳损伤的T梁桥面板，在爆炸荷载下还能保持怎样的抗力。

sections.title: 用有限元分析响应，用机器学习预测位移
paragraphs: 研究采用TNT当量法处理沸腾液体膨胀蒸气爆炸（BLEVE）荷载，并建立T梁桥面板有限元模型，分析疲劳对抗爆性能的影响，随后通过参数分析识别敏感参数。摘要未展开疲劳损伤如何引入模型及爆炸荷载的具体设置。
在此基础上，作者建立了爆炸荷载下疲劳损伤T梁桥面板最大位移的机器学习预测模型，并采用5折交叉验证与贝叶斯超参数优化。摘要明确了预测目标和优化方式，但未给出所用算法及模型输入变量。

sections.title: 疲劳削弱抗爆性能，TNT当量最为敏感
paragraphs: 摘要报告，疲劳显著削弱了T梁桥面板的抗爆性能，跨中位移增加幅度最高达2倍。作者将这一现象主要归因于耗能机制的差异。这提示我们，理解响应变化不能只看位移大小，也需要关注结构如何耗散爆炸输入的能量。
参数分析显示，TNT当量是所考察参数中最敏感的参数，放大效应最高达1.8倍。不过，摘要未明确这一放大效应的具体指标与比较基准。作者将整体方法定位为长期服役桥梁爆炸损伤评估的一种可靠、高效途径，但摘要未提供预测误差或计算效率的量化结果。

sections.title: 摘要尚不足以界定模型适用范围
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断有限元工况及机器学习数据的样本规模、疲劳损伤程度、桥面板构造与参数取值范围，也无法确定位移增幅对应的比较基准。实验对照、独立数据验证及工程场景验证的范围同样未在摘要中说明；这不等于论文没有开展这些工作，也意味着当前不能把所报增幅推广为所有在役桥梁的通用结论。

sections.title: 阅读启发：先看损伤表征，再看预测边界
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对于关注结构疲劳与智能运维的读者，进一步阅读时可优先核对两个问题：模型如何描述累积疲劳损伤，最大位移预测在哪些损伤与爆炸荷载范围内得到验证。前者关系到既有状态如何进入抗爆评估，后者关系到预测结果能够支持怎样的判断。摘要中的机器学习模型不宜直接等同于已经验证的现场运维能力。

papers.title: Metamaterials as transducers for structural health monitoring: a critical review and perspective
papers.abstract: Structural health monitoring (SHM) has traditionally relied on distributed sensors, data acquisition systems, signal transmission, and external data processing to assess the condition of engineering structures. Although this sensor-centric paradigm enables reliable damage detection, it remains limited by system complexity, wiring, power consumption, maintenance, and scalability. Recent advances in metamaterials offer an alternative approach in which the material itself participates in sensing by transducing structural responses into measurable information through its engineered architecture. This review examines how architected metamaterials encode, transform, and communicate structural information for next-generation SHM. Recent developments are organized according to the physical domain of the generated information: visual information, including shape transformation, structural colour, mechanochromism, and mechanoluminescence; electromagnetic information, including electrical, capacitive, piezoelectric, triboelectric, radio-frequency, metasurface, and passive wireless responses; and wave information, including elastic-wave propagation, bandgaps, resonance shifts, mode conversion, localization, and mechanical filtering;. Enabling technologies, including inverse design, topology optimization, additive manufacturing, machine learning, and digital twins, are highlighted for developing multifunctional metamaterials capable of sensing, filtering, amplifying, and communicating structural information. Finally, future opportunities and challenges are outlined for material-centric SHM, in which architected materials evolve from passive structural components into intrinsically intelligent systems that physically process and communicate information before it reaches conventional electronic systems.
papers.summary: 本文是一篇摘要级可核对的综述，讨论如何让超材料通过人工设计的架构，将结构响应转换为可测信息，从而补充传统依赖传感器、布线和外部处理的结构健康监测体系。作者按视觉、电磁和波动信息梳理相关技术，并列出逆向设计、拓扑优化、增材制造、机器学习和数字孪生等支撑手段。[摘要] 解读：其阅读价值主要在于建立材料架构与监测功能之间的分类框架，而非提供已验证的统一工程方案；当前摘要未给出定量性能比较。

raw_metadata.title: Metamaterials as transducers for structural health monitoring: a critical review and perspective
raw_metadata.abstract: Structural health monitoring (SHM) has traditionally relied on distributed sensors, data acquisition systems, signal transmission, and external data processing to assess the condition of engineering structures. Although this sensor-centric paradigm enables reliable damage detection, it remains limited by system complexity, wiring, power consumption, maintenance, and scalability. Recent advances in metamaterials offer an alternative approach in which the material itself participates in sensing by transducing structural responses into measurable information through its engineered architecture. This review examines how architected metamaterials encode, transform, and communicate structural information for next-generation SHM. Recent developments are organized according to the physical domain of the generated information: visual information, including shape transformation, structural colour, mechanochromism, and mechanoluminescence; electromagnetic information, including electrical, capacitive, piezoelectric, triboelectric, radio-frequency, metasurface, and passive wireless responses; and wave information, including elastic-wave propagation, bandgaps, resonance shifts, mode conversion, localization, and mechanical filtering;. Enabling technologies, including inverse design, topology optimization, additive manufacturing, machine learning, and digital twins, are highlighted for developing multifunctional metamaterials capable of sensing, filtering, amplifying, and communicating structural information. Finally, future opportunities and challenges are outlined for material-centric SHM, in which architected materials evolve from passive structural components into intrinsically intelligent systems that physically process and communicate information before it reaches conventional electronic systems.

article.lead: 结构健康监测能否不再只依赖外加传感器，而让材料本身参与感知？这篇综述关注超材料如何通过人工设计的结构，将结构响应转化为可测信息，为理解“以材料为中心”的监测思路提供线索。

sections.title: 从外加传感器转向材料参与感知
paragraphs: 传统结构健康监测依靠分布式传感器、数据采集、信号传输与外部数据处理判断结构状态。摘要指出，这种模式能够实现可靠的损伤检测，但仍受到系统复杂性、布线、功耗、维护和规模扩展等因素限制。
超材料提供的替代思路，是利用经过设计的材料架构，把结构响应转化为可测量的信息。关注点由此从“如何布置传感器”，拓展到“材料结构如何参与信息生成与传递”。

sections.title: 按信息物理域梳理超材料换能方式
paragraphs: 这是一篇综述，而非摘要中报告单一装置实验的研究。作者围绕超材料如何编码、转换和传递结构信息展开讨论，并按生成信息的物理域，将相关进展组织为视觉信息、电磁信息和波信息。
摘要还强调逆向设计、拓扑优化、增材制造、机器学习和数字孪生等支撑技术，讨论它们与多功能超材料发展的联系；但未交代文献检索策略、筛选标准或具体设计流程。

sections.title: 视觉、电磁与波响应构成不同信息通道
paragraphs: 摘要归纳的视觉通道包括形状变换、结构色、力致变色和力致发光；电磁通道涉及电学、电容、压电、摩擦电、射频、超表面及无源无线响应。这些分类展示了结构信息可以采用不同的物理形式表达。
波信息通道则涵盖弹性波传播、带隙、共振偏移、模式转换、局域化与机械滤波。综述关注的功能不止感知，还包括信息的滤波、放大和传递；不过，摘要没有提供各类方案的定量性能对比。
让材料在信息进入传统电子系统之前参与物理处理与通信，是作者提出的未来方向。它应被理解为综述展望，而不是已经得到统一验证的工程效果。

sections.title: 摘要不足以判断性能与工程适用边界
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断被综述研究的样本规模、材料体系、载荷条件、比较基线及验证范围，也无法确认不同换能方式在灵敏度、稳定性或维护需求上的优劣。这里的信息缺口不等于论文没有讨论这些问题。
摘要也未说明机器学习和数字孪生分别承担哪些具体任务，因此不能据此宣称已实现故障预测、寿命估计，或证明材料方案可以替代完整的传统监测系统。

sections.title: 阅读启发：追问信息在哪里被处理
paragraphs: 阅读启发：后续阅读可关注，材料架构究竟完成了响应转换、信息筛选还是信号放大，哪些环节仍依赖外部电子系统。这比笼统地称材料为“智能系统”，更有助于理解其实际功能边界。
对于智能运维与结构设计读者，建议进一步核对逆向设计、拓扑优化和机器学习如何对应具体换能目标，以及相关能力在什么条件下得到验证，而不把支撑技术的出现直接视为监测性能提升的证据。

papers.title: Analysis of the Performance of Aluminum and Titanium Alloys in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Structures Using Machine Learning Models
papers.venue: Bilad Alrafidain Journal for Engineering Science and Technology
papers.abstract: The dataset used in this research is a well-curated collection of aluminum and titanium alloy samples, compiled from experimentally reported values and reliable literature sources for UAV structural applications. The dataset created using this methodology can simulate engineering practices that use common material systems found in aerospace structures. The dataset provides a comprehensive evaluation of material properties by integrating information from various sources to capture genuine physical, mechanical, fatigue, and operational properties. The study emphasizes the variety of material attributes and the engineering importance of the attributes selected, because these factors determine the accuracy of modeling UAV material selection within a complex multi-criteria system. Each sample's material description includes 12 attributes: density, Young's modulus, yield strength, ultimate tensile strength, fatigue strength, fatigue life, hardness, corrosion resistance, weldability, cost level, and availability. The machine learning models consider both quantitative and qualitative parameters to examine how design requirements interact in nonlinear ways. The selected aluminum and titanium alloys were chosen for this study because they frequently appear in UAV systems, which establishes the dataset as both a theoretical and practical research foundation. The developed machine learning models show improved reliability and generalization, and they provide engineering value for UAV structural design and material selection.

sections.title: 从实体模型的成本转向计算模拟选型
paragraphs: 水资源工程研究常需要借助模型分析实际问题。摘要指出，过去数十年间，研究者开发了多种计算机模拟模型，为成本较高、耗时较长的实体模型提供替代途径。当可用软件不断增多，选择依据就不能只是软件是否常见，还需要理解模型的方法特点与应用对象。

sections.title: 围绕科研应用梳理水文与水力软件
paragraphs: 这份摘要描述的是一项综述，而非新建预测模型的实验研究。其工作是回顾模拟模型及其应用的相关研究，重点关注已经在科学研究中使用的水文与水力模拟软件，并从模型特征、方法和应用差异等方面进行分析。摘要没有列出具体软件名称，也未交代文献检索与筛选流程。

sections.title: 摘要强调比较框架，未给出软件优劣结论

papers.title: Predictive Models of Fatigue Failure in Steel Bridges under Severe Dynamic Loading: An Advanced Fracture-Mechanics, Probabilistic, and Digital-Twin Framework
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Sudden failures of steel bridges are frequently associated with fatigue cracks that initiate at welded joints, geometric discontinuities, bolted connections, orthotropic decks, diaphragm attachments, and corrosion-damaged regions. Although fatigue failure is usually a progressive phenomenon, its final stage can occur abruptly when a subcritical crack reaches a critical size and the stress-intensity factor exceeds the fracture toughness of the material. Under high dynamic loading, the conventional static stress-range approach may be insufficient because structural inertia, resonance, traffic-induced vibration, impact effects, mixed-mode fracture, corrosion, residual stress, and uncertainty in the actual load spectrum interact simultaneously.This paper develops an advanced predictive framework for steel-bridge fatigue failure based on the coupling of structural dynamics, elastic and elastic–plastic fracture mechanics, stochastic traffic loading, probabilistic reliability, sensor-based condition assessment, and digital-twin technology. The central mathematical model combines the dynamic equation of motion, rainflow-derived stress spectra, nonlinear fatigue damage accumulation, crack-growth laws based on the Paris–Erdogan and Forman equations, and a limit-state reliability function. The proposed framework further incorporates Bayesian updating and physics-informed machine learning to reduce uncertainty using strain gauges, accelerometers, acoustic-emission sensors, weigh-in-motion systems, and machine-vision inspection. The most reliable fatigue-prediction technology is not a single predictive algorithm but a multi-layered system combining mechanics-based analysis, continuous monitoring, probabilistic inference, and conservative maintenance decision-making.
papers.summary: 钢桥疲劳裂纹通常渐进扩展，但达到临界尺寸后可能突然失效。本文摘要提出将结构动力学、断裂力学、随机交通荷载、概率可靠性及数字孪生耦合的预测框架，并利用监测数据开展贝叶斯更新与物理信息机器学习。其重点是多层系统协同，而非单一预测算法。当前仅有摘要，可了解方法构成与研究主张，无法核实预测精度、工程验证或维护收益。[摘要]

article.lead: 钢桥疲劳裂纹通常逐步扩展，最终失效却可能突然发生。这项研究提出将动力学、断裂力学、监测与概率推断结合的预测框架，其阅读价值在于理解强动态荷载下，疲劳评估为何不能只依赖静态应力幅或单一算法。

sections.title: 渐进裂纹为何可能导致突然失效
paragraphs: 摘要指出，钢桥疲劳裂纹常起始于焊接接头、几何不连续处、螺栓连接、正交异性桥面板、横隔板连接部位及腐蚀损伤区域。当亚临界裂纹达到临界尺寸，且应力强度因子超过材料断裂韧度时，渐进损伤的末期可能转为突然破坏。
强动态荷载使这一问题更加复杂：结构惯性、共振、交通诱发振动、冲击、混合型断裂、腐蚀、残余应力和实际荷载谱的不确定性同时作用。因此，传统静态应力幅方法可能不足以描述相关失效风险。

sections.title: 把动力响应、裂纹扩展与可靠性纳入同一框架
paragraphs: 研究提出耦合结构动力学、弹性与弹塑性断裂力学、随机交通荷载、概率可靠性、传感器状态评估及数字孪生的预测框架。核心数学模型结合动力运动方程、雨流计数得到的应力谱、非线性疲劳损伤累积、基于 Paris–Erdogan 和 Forman 方程的裂纹扩展规律，以及极限状态可靠性函数。
框架还引入贝叶斯更新与物理信息机器学习，拟利用应变计、加速度计、声发射传感器、动态称重系统和机器视觉检测信息降低不确定性。这里的“不确定性降低”是摘要陈述的方法目标，并非已给出量化验证的效果。

sections.title: 摘要强调多层协同，而非单算法胜出
paragraphs: 摘要给出的主要结论是：可靠的疲劳预测不应依靠单一预测算法，而应结合力学分析、连续监测、概率推断和保守的维护决策。这是作者对预测体系组成的判断；摘要没有报告可用于比较算法优劣或预测精度提升的定量结果。

sections.title: 框架已被描述，验证范围仍待核实
paragraphs: 仅凭本次完整摘要，无法判断研究涉及多少座桥梁、多少试件或监测样本，也无法确定荷载与材料参数范围、对照方法、误差指标以及现场验证情况。摘要未报告这些信息，不等于论文没有开展相关工作；当前也不能据此认定该框架已优于既有方法，或已验证其工程维护效果。

paragraphs: 阅读启发：对智能运维与疲劳可靠性研究，更值得进一步核对的是，监测信息具体更新哪些模型参数或不确定性，物理信息机器学习如何与裂纹扩展规律衔接，以及可靠性判断如何关联保守维护决策。这些问题来自摘要所列模块之间的关系，属于后续阅读方向，而非本文已被证实的结论。

papers.title: Multiscale Leakage Modeling of PEMFC Gasket–MEA Frame Interfaces: A Mini-Review
papers.abstract: To meet the stringent durability requirements of proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) for heavy-duty applications, sealing reliability must be evaluated beyond the initial assembly state and linked to the long-term evolution of interfacial contact and gas-loss behavior. This mini-review focuses on gasket–MEA frame sealing interfaces in PEMFCs, with particular emphasis on flexible–flexible contact. It systematically examines recent progress in multiscale geometric characterization and reconstruction, constitutive and contact evolution under assembly and service loads, the competition between interfacial leakage and bulk material permeation, and the development of predictive modeling strategies from deterministic simulations to uncertainty-aware and data-assisted frameworks. The review highlights power spectral density (PSD)- and fractal-based surface reconstruction methods, discusses visco-hyperelastic and chemo-thermo-mechanical descriptions relevant to elastomer aging and contact-pressure retention, and clarifies that gas-loss behavior depends on a service-dependent transition between pressure-driven interfacial leakage and temperature-sensitive bulk permeation. It further summarizes multiscale transport modeling approaches involving slip-flow and Knudsen-scale effects, as well as recent advances in fluid–structure interaction, stochastic tolerance analysis, and surrogate-assisted prediction. Finally, the review outlines key future needs in lifecycle-oriented interface modeling, in situ experimental validation, benchmark data sets, and the integration of physics-informed machine learning with multiscale leakage prediction for health-state assessment and predictive maintenance of PEMFC stacks.
papers.summary: 本文是一篇面向重载质子交换膜燃料电池密封可靠性的简评，聚焦垫片—膜电极组件边框的柔性—柔性接触界面。摘要梳理表面重构、材料老化与接触演化、界面泄漏和材料体相渗透的竞争，以及多尺度输运和不确定性预测方法。核心认识是密封评价不能停留于初始装配状态，而应关联服役中的接触与气体损失演化。作者提出原位验证、基准数据集和物理信息机器学习等未来需求；本解读仅依据摘要，不涉及全文实验核验。[摘要]

papers.title: Quantum Topological Neural Operators and Digital Twin Intelligence for Multiscale Climate, Energy, Hydrological, Urban, Industrial and Health Systems
papers.venue: International Journal of Academic and Industrial Research Innovations(IJAIRI)
papers.abstract: Abstract: Complex climate, energy, hydrological, urban, industrial and health systems are increasingly monitored through heterogeneous sensor, simulation and observational infrastructures, yet their digital twins remain fragmented by domain-specific models, incompatible scales and weak representations of nonlinear topology. This paper develops a unified model-based framework termed Quantum Topological Neural Operator Digital Twin Intelligence (QTNODT). The framework combines persistent and graph-topological representations, quantum or quantum-inspired feature encodings, neural operators for learning solution mappings between function spaces, digital-twin data assimilation, uncertainty quantification and risk-aware optimisation. The study synthesises the supplied literature on neural operators, quantum machine intelligence, topological learning, smart-grid stability, water twins, urban resilience, predictive-maintenance twins, climate-risk modelling and multimodal health intelligence. A coupled mathematical formulation is proposed in which sector states evolve through dynamic operators and are linked by cross-sector interaction matrices, while topological signatures act as scale-robust structural constraints. A normalized 0-10 numerical demonstration yields a weighted domain score of 8.141 and a risk-adjusted QTNODT score of 7.813 under an illustrative uncertainty penalty, indicating how readiness, twin fidelity, topological stability, computational capacity and governance can be combined without presenting simulated values as empirical evidence. The framework contributes a common analytical language for cross-domain forecasting, resilience assessment and intervention design. Its principal value is methodological: it specifies testable interfaces among data, topology, operators, twins and decisions, while making clear that empirical validation requires real-world sector datasets, benchmark comparisons and prospective evaluation. Keywords: quantum topological intelligence; neural operators; digital twins; persistent homology; graph topology; climate risk; smart grids; hydrological intelligence; urban resilience; Industry 5.0; predictive maintenance; precision health; uncertainty quantification; multiscale systems; scientific machine learning

article.lead: 跨领域数字孪生的难点，不只是数据来源不同，还在于模型尺度不兼容、系统结构难以统一表达。这项研究提出QTNODT框架，尝试连接拓扑、神经算子与风险决策；阅读价值在于理解其方法接口，而非把示例评分当作应用成效。

sections.title: 数据越来越多，数字孪生为何仍然割裂
paragraphs: 气候、能源、水文、城市、工业和健康系统，正通过异构传感器、仿真与观测基础设施持续获得数据。但摘要指出，各领域专用模型、互不兼容的尺度，以及对非线性拓扑结构的薄弱表达，仍使数字孪生彼此割裂。研究希望为跨领域预测、韧性评估和干预设计建立共同的分析语言。

sections.title: 用拓扑约束与动态算子连接领域状态
paragraphs: 作者综合神经算子、量子机器智能、拓扑学习及多个应用领域的文献，提出“量子拓扑神经算子数字孪生智能”（QTNODT）框架。其组成包括持久性与图拓扑表征、量子或量子启发式特征编码、学习函数空间之间解映射的神经算子，以及数字孪生数据同化、不确定性量化和风险感知优化。
在所提出的耦合数学表述中，各领域状态通过动态算子演化，跨领域交互矩阵负责建立联系，拓扑特征则作为具有尺度稳健性的结构约束。这里描述的是框架组成与数学关系，不能据此认定它已在量子硬件上实现，或已完成跨领域系统部署。

sections.title: 评分演示展示整合方式，不代表实证性能
paragraphs: 摘要报告了一项归一化至0–10的数值演示：加权领域得分为8.141，在示例性不确定性惩罚下，风险调整后的QTNODT得分为7.813。演示用于说明如何综合就绪程度、孪生保真度、拓扑稳定性、计算能力与治理因素，**不是对真实系统性能的实证测量**。
研究明确将主要价值定位于方法论：为数据、拓扑、算子、孪生和决策之间规定可检验的接口。因此，当前可概括的成果是统一框架与评分整合示例，而不是已经证明预测更准确、系统更可靠或干预更有效。

sections.title: 真实数据、基准比较与前瞻验证仍是关键
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断实际样本规模与构成、比较基线的设置，以及验证覆盖哪些领域、尺度和运行条件；这些信息未报告，不等于论文没有涉及。摘要明确指出，实证验证需要真实领域数据集、基准比较和前瞻性评估。因此，数值演示不足以支持跨领域泛化能力或量子相关性能优势的结论。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注预测维护中的接口如何落地
paragraphs: 阅读启发：面向智能运维，可进一步关注框架如何把设备状态数据、拓扑表征、动态预测与风险决策对应起来。后续阅读值得追问：这些接口如何被具体定义？不确定性怎样进入评分与决策？预测维护场景中的证据来自示例还是实际评估？这些问题有助于区分框架的组织价值与尚待验证的应用效果。

papers.title: Machine Learning for Structural Steels: Materials Design, Property Prediction, Durability, and Future Directions
papers.abstract: Machine learning (ML) provides new opportunities to model the nonlinear relationships among composition, processing, microstructure, defects, properties, and in-service degradation of structural steels. This structured critical review examines ML applications to materials and process design, microstructural characterization, mechanical-property prediction, corrosion, fire and elevated-temperature performance, fatigue, fracture, and remaining-life assessment. Literature published up to 31 July 2026 was searched primarily through the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus. A total of 110 publications were retained based on their relevance to structural steels, transparency of data and modeling procedures, and availability of information on validation or engineering applicability. The reviewed studies show that model suitability depends strongly on data modality, sample independence, feature representation, and validation strategy rather than on algorithm family alone. ML has progressed from property prediction toward process optimization, inverse materials design, environmental degradation assessment, and fatigue- and crack-related prognostics. However, independent cross-manufacturer, cross-laboratory, production-scale, and field validation remains limited, while uncertainty quantification and applicability-domain assessment are still inconsistently reported. These limitations are particularly important for corrosion, fire, fatigue, and remaining-life applications, where internally validated models should not be interpreted as substitutes for established physical models or design provisions. Future research should prioritize standardized multimodal data, physics-informed and uncertainty-aware modeling, prospective validation, and rigorously evaluated closed-loop monitoring and digital-twin frameworks for structural-steel life-cycle management.
papers.summary: 本文是结构钢机器学习应用的结构化批判性综述，覆盖材料与工艺设计、力学性能预测、腐蚀、火灾、疲劳及剩余寿命评估，纳入110篇文献。[摘要] 作者强调，模型适用性不能只看算法，还取决于数据、样本独立性与验证策略。跨来源和现场验证不足，使工程应用仍需谨慎。解读：本文适合梳理可靠性研究中的验证要求，但本次仅有摘要，不能核查具体模型和性能比较。

papers.title: Benchmarking Model Compression Techniques Across Heterogeneous Edge Platforms: A Predictive Maintenance Use Case for Rotating Machinery
papers.abstract: To enable Industry 5.0, where autonomous systems are widely adopted and integrated with people to promote sustainable development in industries, it is imperative to adapt complex deep learning models to operate efficiently on resource-constrained hardware for edge inference. However, adapting these models remains challenging due to the hardware heterogeneity of edge computing in industrial settings, performance degradation caused by model compression, and the lack of clear guidance on which compression techniques are practical and effective for applications such as predictive maintenance. To address these challenges, this paper presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of four state-of-the-art model compression techniques applied to a high-performance convolutional neural network for predictive maintenance using a real-world dataset of rotating machinery, equipment typically used in industry. The compressed models were evaluated across a heterogeneous set of nine computing platforms, ranging from highly constrained edge computing devices to general purpose and high-performance processors, reflecting the diversity and fragmentation typical of industrial edge environments. By jointly prioritizing classification performance, inference speed, and compression ratio, we found that compression using knowledge distillation emerged as the most effective approach. The model had more than 90% speedup across all devices while maintaining a 91.22% balanced F-score, with a very small drop in predictive performance relative to the uncompressed model, along with a 98.9% size reduction. Through successful deployment across multiple edge platforms and a systematic comparison of compression strategies, we demonstrated a clear path to achieving Industry 5.0 targets, drastically cutting computational costs and, consequently, energy consumption without sacrificing predictive performance.

papers.title: Prior knowledge informed neural network based on Basquin’s formula for predicting fatigue life
papers.abstract: This study introduces a prior knowledge-informed neural network (PKiNN) for predicting material fatigue life. The prior knowledge module generates data adhering to S-N curve characteristics, while a pure data-driven module assesses factors like stress concentration from notches. By merging these outputs through a single-layer fully connected neural network, fatigue life predictions are obtained. Experimental validation confirmed PKiNN’s superior extrapolation capabilities compared to traditional machine learning (ML) approaches. Moreover, PKiNN’s predictive performance is less dependent on specific training data set choices, distinguishing it from current informed ML methods.

It discusses conventional machine learning, deep learning, signal-processing and hybrid approaches, evaluation metrics, robustness, interpretability, cybersecurity, and deployment challenges. The manuscript highlights the importance of transparent datasets, realistic validation, and safe integration with conventional protection systems. This work is a literature-based review and does not report new experimental results.

papers.title: A Study on an Optimized Method for Wind Turbine Fault Diagnosis Based on Deep Learning Algorithms
papers.abstract: Abstract To solve the problems of low fault characteristics, imbalance of fault classifications and low identification stability among operating conditions in wind turbines of various speed, loads and disturbance of noise the current study is aimed at providing a multi-source monitoring signal fault diagnosis method which would be optimized. Synchronous vibration, current, temperature, rotational speed, and power data modeling provided the foundation to a multi-domain feature extraction process and a diagnostic framework was created, incorporating temporal representation, texture coding, category reweighting, operating condition alignment, and decision calibration. The experimental findings indicate that this approach has a high recognition consistency in various types of faults and complex operating conditions, with large gains in the recall of rare faults and cross-operating-condition diagnosis, and is thus applicable to fault identification in the intelligent operation and maintenance of wind turbines.

papers.title: Physical-Variable-Informed Deep Learning for Robust Diagnosis in Industrial Fluid Transport Systems
papers.abstract: Industrial fluid transport systems are monitored through heterogeneous sensing streams, but robust fault diagnosis remains difficult because response signals vary with operating conditions and differ from physical variables in sampling rate, observation duration and data granularity. To address these challenges, we propose a physical-variable-informed deep learning framework (PhyNet) for robust fault diagnosis under real-world sampling heterogeneity. PhyNet treats physical variables as global operating constraints and response signals as local diagnostic evidence. Its physical-to-response cross-attention mechanism connects sequence-level physical-variable tokens with a learnable global response token, enabling interaction without strict temporal alignment. Across four benchmarks, including three real-world cavitation datasets and one public two-phase-flow dataset, PhyNet achieves the best performance across all evaluated metrics. Class-wise analyses, together with attention and masking analyses, show improved discrimination of ambiguous states and indicate that physical variables meaningfully constrain local response interpretation. These findings demonstrate a deployment-oriented approach to robust diagnosis in heterogeneous industrial environments.

papers.title: Structural Performance of Crumb Rubber-Modified Asphalt Under Service Conditions: A Mechanistic and Machine-Learning Assessment
papers.abstract: Crumb rubber (CR) modification offers a sustainable approach to improving asphalt performance while promoting the beneficial reuse of end-of-life tyres. This study evaluates the structural performance of CR-modified hot mix asphalt (HMA) under service conditions through an integrated mechanistic and machine-learning framework. Laboratory-measured resilient moduli for conventional and 15% CR-modified HMA at 20, 40, and 60 °C were incorporated into a three-layer Odemark–Shell analysis considering 11 asphalt-layer thicknesses and three representative seasonal temperature periods established from an 11-year (2015–2025) climatic record for Karbala, Iraq. Pavement performance was assessed for a 20-year design period under 6 × 106 equivalent single axle loads (ESALs), with fatigue and rutting damage accumulated using Miner’s rule. Eight machine-learning algorithms were additionally evaluated as fast surrogate models for predicting the critical pavement responses. Incorporating CR increased the resilient modulus by 8.5–9.2%, resulting in reductions of 9.7–10.4% in horizontal tensile strain and 1.2–2.8% in vertical compressive strain over the investigated temperature range. The continuous interpolation of the fatigue-damage criterion indicated required asphalt thicknesses of approximately 27.3 cm for conventional HMA and 25.8 cm for CR-modified HMA, corresponding to a reduction of approximately 1.5 cm (5–6%). At the common 27.5 cm design thickness, CR modification reduced the governing fatigue damage index from 0.954 to 0.723, representing a 24.2% reduction in accumulated fatigue damage and increasing the estimated service life from approximately 21.0 to 27.7 years. Gradient Boosting achieved surrogate-model fidelity, with R2 values of 0.993 and 0.9998 for the critical strain responses, while asphalt-layer thickness emerged as the dominant performance variable, consistent with the known analytical structure of the governing equations. The use of CR could additionally divert approximately 10.9 tonnes of scrap tyre rubber from the landfill per lane-kilometre. The findings demonstrate that the CR modification can reduce the continuously estimated required asphalt thickness and extend the theoretical pavement service life under the adopted assumptions, although the thickness reduction is not resolved when standard 2.5 cm construction increments are considered. Additionally, CR modification provides measurable sustainability benefits through the reuse of scrap-tyre rubber.

papers.title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Large-scale topology optimization (TO) remains computationally demanding, especially for stress-constrained problems. To address this challenge, we propose the simultaneous neural topology optimization (SNTO) framework where we represent state, adjoint, and design variables with custom neural networks (NNs) whose parameters are jointly optimized within a single optimization loop that leverages continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation. This optimization minimizes a multi-component loss function that combines the design objective, an aggregation of the local stress constraints, and the potential energy functionals. Our NNs have a unique architecture that accelerates convergence while enabling the networks to capture sharp gradients and boundaries which are critical to stress-constrained TO. To achieve scalability to millions of degrees of freedom (DoF), we develop a hardware-aware training scheme in which the design domain is partitioned into subdomains that are distributed across multiple GPUs. To control peak GPU memory usage, we further slice each subdomain into smaller regions whose loss gradients are evaluated sequentially and accumulated to update the NN parameters. Unlike domain decomposition approaches, our partitioning naturally ensures field continuity across the subdomains and does not require the introduction of additional terms into the loss function. For validation, we first evaluate the proposed framework on various 2D stress-constrained benchmarks and compare our results to a conventional finite element-based approach, showing that SNTO produces super-resolution designs with sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions. We then consider large-scale 3D problems with up to eight million collocation points and distribute the training over up to eight GPUs.

papers.title: CAST: Cast-Admissible Generative Design and Shape Optimization with Paired Depth Images
papers.abstract: Deep generative design can produce complex geometries, but unconstrained representations may create undercuts that prevent release from a two-part mold. We present CAST, which reformulates three-dimensional shape generation under a selected mold-opening constraint as a two-dimensional image generation problem using paired top and bottom depth images. Each valid depth pair defines one material interval along a selected mold-opening direction, so reconstructions exclude undercuts in that direction by construction. Diffusion models generate candidate shapes in this representation, and a finite element analysis (FEA) guided optimizer refines the same two boundaries. We evaluate diffusion-based generation with limited training data comprising 211 SimJEB bracket designs. On SimJEB brackets, FEA-guided refinement with a volume penalty reduced compliance in 193 of 200 generated candidates. The median reduction across all candidates was 36.8 percent in the optimization FEA model. Reconstruction of existing brackets revealed a mass--stiffness trade-off: filling occluded regions increased material volume and reduced displacement under the evaluated loads. Paired depth images thus connect generative exploration and structural refinement in a shared design space that preserves the selected pull-direction restriction.

papers.title: Motor compound fault diagnosis using an attention-based cross-talk architecture
papers.abstract: As physical AI increasingly relies on sensing to understand physical systems, reliable condition monitoring of industrial machinery has become more important. Motors are ubiquitous in industrial systems, and increasing system complexity raises the likelihood of simultaneous faults. Accordingly, compound fault diagnosis that identifies multiple fault components and their severities is increasingly required. Because different fault components jointly affect the same vibration signal, their severity classification can be formulated as related tasks, making multi-task learning (MTL) suitable for exploiting shared information. However, conventional shared-trunk architectures force tasks to share a common representation, potentially causing negative transfer because fault components are characterized by different time-frequency regions. To address this issue, this study proposes a Residual Neural Dimension Reductor with Time-Frequency Channel Attention (RNDR-TFCA), an attention-enhanced cross-talk architecture for multi-output compound fault diagnosis. RNDR-TFCA preserves task-specific feature extractors while selectively exchanging information across tasks. Time-frequency attention emphasizes informative intra-task regions, while channel attention enhances useful inter-task information after nonlinear feature fusion. Experiments on a rotor-bearing system with inner-race fault, outer-race fault, misalignment, and unbalance showed that RNDR-TFCA achieved a macro F1 score of 0.898, outperforming single-task, multi-class, shared-trunk, and cross-talk baselines. Ablation experiments confirmed the benefit of jointly applying both attention mechanisms. RNDR-TFCA required 713 K parameters and 170.42 MMACs, only slightly higher than RNDR. Channel-expanded baselines still underperformed RNDR-TFCA, indicating that the gain was not simply attributable to increased model capacity.

papers.title: Optimizing Data-Driven Predictive Maintenance in Gas Plants Using Machine Learning-Based Support Vector Machines (SVM): A Case Study on Failure Prediction
papers.venue: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF ENGINEERING AND MODERN TECHNOLOGY
papers.abstract: This study optimized data-driven predictive maintenance in gas plant using machine learning based Support Vector Machines (SVM) in predicting failures. The application software was developed to improve the operational efficiency and reliability of turbo-compressors in gas injection plants. The Gas injection plant produced below maximum capacity due to failure problems of the Turbo-compressors, these affected the targeted oil production negatively. The unavailability and unreliable gas plant led to revenue losses. Machine learning techniques using Support Vector Machines (SVM), was employed to develop the failure predictive application software. According to the findings, the Efficient Linear SVM model detected failures with a 99.5% true positive rate and classified non-failure events with a 99.9% classification precision. Although it showed a 0.5% false negative rate, the Boosted Trees model obtained a 99.5% true positive rate (TPR) for failure detection, underscoring the need for additional optimization and integration with ensemble approaches to reduce operational risks. Additionally, the SVM model demonstrated a minimum false negative occurrence and 99.9% classification precision for non-failure events. The outcomes of this study yielded a highly effective, computationally efficient machine learning-based application software capable of reliably predicting turbo-compressor failures. The study concluded that the developed application software is a powerful tool for predicting failures in gas injection plants, supporting decision-making processes, and enhancing operational safety. Recommendations for future works included refining existing models, exploring additional feature engineering techniques, and evaluating the robustness of the models under varying operational conditions.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Tri-Sensor Fusion for Predictive Maintenance: Operational Reliability and Techno-Economic Validation of Rotating Machinery on Oil and Gas Platforms
papers.abstract: Predictive maintenance (PdM) improves the reliability of rotating machinery on oil and gas platforms; however, few studies translate multi-sensor classification into validated reliability and economic outcomes under real industrial deployment. This study develops and operationally validates a deployment-oriented Tri-Sensor decision-support framework integrating vibration, ultrasound, and surface temperature measurements with supervised machine learning for semi-critical rotating machinery on oil and gas platforms. Using 11,136 inspection records from 464 assets across five platforms (2022–2025), four classifiers (Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest) were evaluated under Bi-Sensor (vibration and temperature) and Tri-Sensor (vibration, ultrasound, and temperature) configurations. The Tri-Sensor configuration achieved a Macro-F1 score of approximately 0.97, representing an improvement of approximately 20 percentage points over the Bi-Sensor baseline, confirmed by paired McNemar’s tests (p < 0.001). The results demonstrate that ultrasound integration substantially improves diagnostic performance. Correlation analysis, permutation feature importance, and SHAP interpretation confirmed that all three sensing modalities provide complementary information and contribute to predictions. Beyond classification, model outputs were transformed into a calibrated Health Index and assessed using Cumulative Gains Analysis and Decision Curve Analysis for risk-based maintenance prioritization. Using four years of maintenance and financial records, the framework was associated with an increase in Mean Time Between Failures from 5.16 to 6.44 years. Under the evaluated 20% follow-up scenario, estimated benefits included a 60% reduction in follow-up workload and potential savings of 1108 maintenance labor hours. The five-year assessment yielded a net present value of USD 2.73 million and a return on investment of 226%, while the modeled HSE analysis estimated a 20% reduction in major-incident frequency. These findings support a deployment-oriented framework linking sensor-fusion-based condition monitoring to reliability, maintenance, economic, and safety indicators.

papers.title: Integration of Machine Learning Algorithms for Predictive Maintenance in Electrical Machines
papers.venue: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF ENGINEERING AND MODERN TECHNOLOGY
papers.abstract: Electrical machines are critical assets in laboratories and industries but are often susceptible to failures such as insulation breakdown, overheating, vibration anomalies, and electrical imbalances. Traditional maintenance practices have remained reactive and schedule-based, resulting in costly downtime and safety hazards. The aim of this study is to develop a predictive maintenance framework that integrates machine learning (ML) algorithms with fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) to enhance the reliability of electrical machines. The objectives are to (i) simulate machine faults using MATLAB/Simulink and utilize public datasets, (ii) train and compare ML classifiers including Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Decision Trees, and (iii) evaluate their performance in predicting fault occurrence. Anchored on the Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) theory, the study applies feature extraction techniques such as FFT and wavelet transforms, followed by supervised learning classification. The findings indicate that ANN achieved the highest accuracy (96.5%), precision (95.8%), and recall (97.1%), outperforming both SVM and Decision Tree models. The study concludes that integrating ML into predictive maintenance improves diagnostic accuracy, minimizes downtime, reduces costs, and enhances safety, thereby offering practical applications for both academic and industrial environments.

papers.title: Designing High-Entropy Alloys: From Physical Metallurgy to Machine Learning Enabled Discovery
papers.abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) are characterized by having more than one principal element, in contrast to a traditional alloy with only one base element; this provides a much wider composition space compared to traditional alloys; hence, HEAs have been the most studied metal alloys in the last couple of decades. This review links the fundamentals of these materials to the data-driven methods now used to design them. The first part of this review describes the fundamentals of these materials, including the thermodynamic and kinetic basis of these materials and an entropy-based classification. The subsequent parts of this review describe the synthesis routes of these materials via liquid-state, solid-state, gas-state, and other processing routes. The choice of processing route can have a significant impact on the resulting material, including the phase(s) formed, the chemical homogeneity, and contamination of the material. We have systematically reviewed the mechanical, corrosion, thermal, electrical, and soft magnetic properties of these HEAs. In the final section, we discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) can be used to solve the problem of combinatorial explosion of the design space of HEAs: supervised classifiers for phase prediction, regression and ensemble models for hardness, strength, and elastic moduli, active learning and Bayesian optimization for closed-loop discovery, high-throughput screening with CALPHAD, and machine-learned interatomic potentials. We conclude with continuing constraints such as lack of data, noisy labels, and poor encoding of process history, and areas of development including transfer learning, generative design, and self-driving laboratories.

papers.title: Lyapunov Exponents in Power Systems: A Survey of Theory and Applications in Stability, Control, Forecasting, and Protection
papers.abstract: Lyapunov exponents (LEs) are fundamental metrics from nonlinear dynamical systems theory that quantify the average exponential rate of divergence or convergence of nearby trajectories in phase space. Over the past three decades, LEs have emerged as powerful tools across a wide range of power system problems, including transient and voltage stability assessment, chaos detection and mitigation, short-term load and renewable energy forecasting, and fault diagnosis. This paper presents a comprehensive review of these applications, covering more than 165 publications spanning from the early demonstrations of chaos in simplified machine models (1990s) to the most recent data-driven and machine-learning-augmented approaches applied to inverter-based resource (IBR)-dominated grids (2024--2026). The review is organized into four principal application domains: (i) stability analysis and real-time monitoring, (ii) chaos characterization and control, (iii) forecasting and predictability analysis, and (iv) protection, fault diagnosis, and condition monitoring. For each domain, we trace the evolution of methods, compare model-based and data-driven LE estimation strategies, identify key benchmarks and validation gaps, and outline the most pressing open research problems.

papers.title: The Loss or the Architecture? What Matters in Survival Analysis with Competing Risks
papers.abstract: Often, \emph{eg} in healthcare and predictive maintenance, what matters is which of several competing causes will strike first, and with what probability: survival analysis with competing risks. Corresponding deep learning methods are developed as bundles: a new architecture together with a new training loss, tested on one to five datasets against a handful of baselines. Thus, a state-of-the-art result cannot be attributed to the architecture, the loss, or the evaluation protocol. The coupling is not accidental: with one incidence curve per cause, a network's head is tied to the losses expressible on it. We vary the two axes independently, three losses, two of them strictly proper, on four backbones, across two modalities that tease the axes apart: 20 tabular and 3 pathology-image datasets. One loss wins in both: modelling cumulative incidence directly under censoring weighting. It brings twice as much as benefits a good choice of backbone on competing-risks data, and no more than it on single-event data: the loss is decisive for competing risks. The backbone matters too, and must match the modality: tabular networks lead on tables, pretrained vision encoders on images. The two choices compound rather than substitute. Proper scoring rules reveal these dynamics; the concordance index (C-index), which is not proper, does not separate models: neither axis moves it, not even tuning on the loss built to improve it. This is an avenue of progress: composed, the two give a model nobody has tried, RealMLP or TabM trained with the cumulative-incidence loss, which takes the best Brier score in our benchmark.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Predictive Maintenance for Mechanical Systems: Tool Wear and Bearing Fault Detection Using Vibration and Acoustic Emission Signals
papers.venue: European Journal of Applied Science Engineering and Technology
papers.abstract: Wide automation of high-speed mechanical industries raises the need for abundant day-by-day resource cheerful programs to avoid unreliable apparatus abandonment and cut tool purchase prices along with loss of precision workpiece tolerances. Although mechanical vibration analysis is an accepted benchmarking standard for rotating machinery diagnostics, it suffers from physical latency with early-stage failures and is susceptible to low frequency factory floor noise interference. On the other hand, high frequency acoustic emission (AE) stress waves are sensitive to micro-crack propagation and asperity friction; however, it faces interface attenuation and massive data volume bottlenecks. This paper aims at filling this gap by introducing an intelligent dual-sensor predictive (DDP) maintenance framework that combines synchronous vibration and acoustic emission signals. We develop a multi-branch deep neural network with cross-attention latent fusion for simultaneous classification of localized bearing faults and progression (VB) of continuous cutting tool flank wear land. The proposed model is evaluated with PHM 2010 Milling Challenge and Paderborn Bearing benchmarks, showing 99.28% multi-class accuracy on inner race, outer race, and ball bearing faults whilst achieving a low flank wear prediction error (RMSE = 5.14 µm, R² = 0.982). Ablation benchmarks demonstrate that cross-attention fusion significantly beats isolated single-sensor baselines, especially during incipient degradation (resulting in 98.90% F1-score for AE-driven attention). Additionally, the system exhibits good zero to large perturbation resilience by upholding ~94% prediction accuracy with extreme Gaussian noise (-6 dB) and 1.84 ms inference latency on an embedded NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, establishing its real-time edge tier industrial deployment potential.

papers.title: Fault diagnosis of rotating systems with journal bearing wear using machine learning models
papers.abstract: Η δυναμική συμπεριφορά ενός περιστρεφόμενου συστήματος επηρεάζεται σημαντικά από τα χαρακτηριστικά των εδράνων στήριξης. Η παρουσία φθοράς στα έδρανα ολίσθησης έχει άμεση επιρροή στην λειτουργία και την απόκριση του συστήματος. Στην παρούσα διπλωματική εργασία παρουσιάζεται η δυναμική συμπεριφορά ενός περιστρεφόμενου συστήματος που μελετήθηκε στην σπουδαστική εργασία και διερευνάται η δυνατότητα αναγνώρισης φθοράς εδράνων ολίσθησης με χρήση Τεχνητών Νευρωνικών Δικτύων. Αρχικά παρουσιάζεται το απαραίτητο θεωρητικό υπόβαθρο της δυναμικής συμπεριφοράς περιστρεφόμενων συστημάτων, των εδράνων ολίσθησης και την επίδραση της φθοράς των εδράνων στην συμπεριφορά των περιστρεφόμενων συστημάτων. Για την διερεύνηση της επιρροής της φθοράς αναπτύσσεται αριθμητική διαδικασία στο MATLAB, βασισμένη στην εξίσωση Reynolds, μέσω της οποίας υπολογίζονται η κατανομή πίεσης του λιπαντικού, η θέση ισορροπίας του άξονα και οι δυναμικοί συντελεστές δυσκαμψίας και απόσβεσης των εδράνων για διαφορετικές ταχύτητες περιστροφής και επίπεδα φθοράς. Στη συνέχεια παρουσιάζονται τα αποτελέσματα της σπουδαστικής εργασίας για την δυναμική απόκριση του συστήματος. Προσδιορίζονται οι ιδιοσυχνότητες, ιδιομορφές και κρίσιμες ταχύτητες για το σύστημα και η αριθμητική μεθοδολογία πιστοποιείται μέσω σύγκρισης με δημοσιευμένα αποτελέσματα της βιβλιογραφίας. Επιπλέον εξετάζεται η απόκριση του συστήματος υπό διέγερση λόγω αζυγοσταθμίας. Τέλος, δημιουργείται σύνολο 230 δειγμάτων, αποτελούμενο από την ταχύτητα περιστροφής και τους συντελεστές δυσκαμψίας και απόσβεσης για υγιή και φθαρμένα έδρανα. Με βάση τα δεδομένα αναπτύσσονται και συγκρίνονται τρεις διαφορετικές αρχιτεκτονικές τεχνητών νευρωνικών δικτύων για δυαδική ταξινόμηση της κατάστασης του εδράνου. Και οι τρεις αρχιτεκτονικές επιτυγχάνουν ακρίβεια 100% στο εξωτερικό σύνολο ελέγχου, ενώ ως τελικό μοντέλο επιλέγεται το δίκτυο 9–15–2. papers.title: Programmable design of functional RNAs through multimodal generative learning
papers.abstract: Abstract RNA engineering is bottlenecked by the tight coupling among sequence, structure, and function, leaving the field reliant on heuristics or screening. We introduce RNAverse, a multimodal generative model that learns a conditionable design grammar from RNA sequences, experimental structural probing profiles, and functional annotations. Beyond setting a new state of the art across 16 predictive modeling tasks, RNAverse inverts into generative design across four distinct RNA classes through three regimes, requiring experimental testing of no more than 20 candidates per-task. Zero-shot in-painting generates snoRNAs that promote premature termination codon (PTC) readthrough, and chimeric aptazymes for ligand-controlled gene regulation, exceeding rational design or large-scale screens. In both settings, RNAverse outperforms family-adapted sequence-only baselines. Fine-tuned in-painting extends to an unseen functional class, yielding IGFBP3-binding aptamers with picomolar affinity that outperform SELEX winners. Iterative optimization engineers 5′ UTRs that outperform clinical benchmarks, enhancing protein production in cell-based assays for both the Zolgensma gene therapy and the BNT162b2 COVID-19 vaccine, and boosting antibody responses to BNT162b2 in mice. Together, these results establish multimodal generative learning as a route from predictive RNA modeling to programmable specification of functional RNAs.

papers.title: Machine learning reduces questionnaire items while maintaining reliability and validity
papers.abstract: Traditional long questionnaires often suffer from respondent fatigue, leading to decreased completion rates and compromised data quality. This study introduces a novel algorithmic item-reduction methodology, named NNAQ, designed to streamline high-dimensional survey instruments while strictly preserving both downstream classification capabilities and psychometric construct validity. Operating as a structured case study, the proposed multi-tiered framework strategically orchestrates linear filters, non-linear tree-embedded layers, and information-theoretic criteria. This hybrid architecture allows different mathematical paradigms to cross-validate and error-correct each other, successfully overcoming the limitations of traditional single-stage dimension reduction methods. This study evaluated the framework empirically using an expanded field dataset collected from 1,022 citizens. The experimental results demonstrate that the original 96-item questionnaire can be reduced to a parsimonious 34-item instrument, representing a 64.58% reduction in questionnaire length. Downstream evaluation via machine learning classifiers indicates that the predictive accuracy loss is kept under 5 percent, while comprehensive confirmatory factor analysis confirms that the shortened scale yields superior parsimonious fit indices and stable internal reliability. Furthermore, rigorous bootstrapping resampling and benchmarking experiments against alternative reduction methods validate the exceptional structural stability and empirical superiority of our pipeline. Overall, this research provides a robust, data-efficient, and scalability-tested framework for human-centered digital assessment, effectively mitigating respondent fatigue while securing high-fidelity data quality.

papers.title: Machine Learning-assisted Antenna Design and Optimization: A Comprehensive Review of Surrogate Modeling, Active Learning, and Intelligent Optimization
papers.abstract: The rapid development of wireless communication systems has created an increasing demand for compact, broadband, high-performance, and application-specific antennas. Conventional antenna design approaches generally rely on analytical formulations, empirical relationships, parameter sweeps, and repeated full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulations, which become computationally expensive as the number of design variables increases. To address these challenges, metaheuristic optimisation techniques such as Genetic Algorithm (GA) and Particle Swarm Optimisation (PSO) have been widely investigated for exploring complex antenna design spaces. More recently, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches have been introduced for antenna performance prediction, inverse design, and surrogate-assisted optimisation. These approaches can reduce the computational burden associated with repeated EM simulations; however, their effectiveness often depends on sufficiently large and representative simulation datasets. Hybrid ML–metaheuristic approaches further improve the optimisation process by combining predictive models with intelligent search algorithms, while Active Learning enables the selective acquisition of informative simulation samples. This review presents the evolution of computational antenna design from conventional and metaheuristic approaches to ML-based, hybrid, and Active Learning-driven methodologies. The reviewed studies are critically examined with respect to their design strategies, optimisation techniques, simulation requirements, data dependence, and computational efficiency. Particular emphasis is placed on the role of surrogate modelling and adaptive sample selection in reducing expensive full-wave simulations. The review identifies the limitations of existing approaches and highlights the need for autonomous, data-efficient, and simulation-efficient frameworks for high-dimensional microstrip antenna optimisation.

article.lead: 天线设计变量增多时，反复调用全波电磁仿真的计算负担如何降低？这篇综述围绕代理建模、智能搜索与主动学习，梳理机器学习辅助天线优化的技术演进，阅读价值在于理解计算效率与数据依赖之间的关系。

sections.title: 高维天线设计为何面临仿真成本压力
paragraphs: 无线通信的发展不断提高对紧凑、宽带、高性能及面向特定应用天线的需求。传统设计依赖解析公式、经验关系、参数扫描和反复进行的全波电磁仿真；随着设计变量增加，计算成本随之上升。遗传算法（GA）、粒子群优化（PSO）等元启发式方法因此被广泛研究，用于探索复杂的天线设计空间。

sections.title: 沿技术演进比较设计策略与数据需求
paragraphs: 这是一篇综述，而非摘要中报告了新天线实验的研究。作者梳理了从传统方法、元启发式方法，到机器学习、混合方法及主动学习驱动方法的演进，并从设计策略、优化技术、仿真需求、数据依赖和计算效率等方面审视已有研究。
摘要明确区分了相关方法的作用：机器学习与深度学习用于性能预测、逆向设计和代理辅助优化；混合方法将预测模型与智能搜索算法结合；主动学习则选择性获取信息量较高的仿真样本。综述特别关注代理建模与自适应样本选择如何减少昂贵的全波仿真。

sections.title: 减少仿真调用，仍须面对训练数据依赖
paragraphs: 摘要指出，机器学习方法能够减轻重复电磁仿真的计算负担，但其有效性往往依赖数量充足、具有代表性的仿真数据集。**减少后续仿真计算，并不意味着摆脱数据需求**：这是理解这些方法适用条件的重要线索。
对于混合方法，摘要给出的概括是预测模型与智能搜索的结合可进一步改善优化过程；主动学习则提供了选择性获取仿真样本的途径。综述最终强调，高维微带天线优化仍需要更自主、数据高效且仿真高效的框架。这是作者提出的需求，不是摘要已经验证实现的效果。

sections.title: 摘要不足以判断定量收益与验证边界
paragraphs: 本次解读仅依据完整摘要。摘要未交代纳入研究的数量、检索与筛选规则、各研究的数据规模、具体天线配置、比较基线及验证范围，也未提供误差、仿真调用量或计算时间的定量结果。因此，不能据此判断哪类算法总体更优，也不能确认其结论能否推广到不同设计空间；这些信息仍需查阅正文，而非认定论文未开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：把数据成本与优化收益放在一起看
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对于关注逆向设计与结构优化的读者，可沿着“预测模型依赖什么数据、搜索如何调用模型、主动学习如何选择样本”继续阅读。尤其值得核对的是，文中如何界定数据代表性，以及比较计算效率时是否同时考虑数据生成与优化阶段的成本。这些是由摘要引出的阅读问题，并非已经得到验证的跨领域结论。

paragraphs: 摘要指出，机器学习方法能够减轻重复电磁仿真的计算负担，但其有效性往往依赖数量充足、具有代表性的仿真数据集。**减少后续仿真计算，并不意味着摆脱数据需求**：这是理解这些方法适用条件的重要线索。
对于混合方法，摘要给出的概括是预测模型与智能搜索的结合可进一步改善优化过程；主动学习则提供了选择性获取仿真样本的途径。综述最终强调，高维微带天线优化仍需要更自主、数据高效且仿真高效的框架。这是作者提出的需求，不是摘要已经验证实现的效果。

sections.title: 摘要不足以判断定量收益与验证边界

papers.title: Beyond SELEX: AI-driven aptamers from sequence to structure to function.
papers.abstract: Conventional aptamer discovery by systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment (SELEX) is often constrained by limited library capacity, PCR bias, and multi-round screening. The recent convergence of artificial intelligence with aptamer development is driving a paradigm shift from empirical screening toward rational, data-driven design. This Review presents a timely and comprehensive overview of AI integration across the entire aptamer development pipeline, with a particular emphasis on advances reported in 2024-2026. We begin by discussing bioinformatics databases and computational tools for high-throughput SELEX data analysis. We then review state-of-the-art strategies for secondary and tertiary structure prediction, including recent breakthroughs such as AlphaFold 3, RoseTTAFoldNA, and diffusion-based approaches. We also cover machine learning methods for aptamer-target interaction prediction, molecular docking, dynamics simulations, and free energy calculations. A major focus is placed on very recent AI-driven generative design, including diffusion models (AptaDiff), language model-based frameworks (InstructNA, GRAPE-LM), and reinforcement learning approaches (AiDTA) for de novo aptamer generation and optimization. Emerging applications of AI-designed aptamers in precision diagnostics, targeted therapy, and biosensing are also surveyed. Finally, we discuss current challenges and outline future directions toward closed-loop, interpretable AI frameworks for translational aptamer development. By synthesizing the latest computational and experimental advances, this Review aims to serve as a timely resource for researchers seeking to leverage AI for next-generation aptamer discovery.

sections.title: 传统筛选的瓶颈：文库容量与筛选偏差
paragraphs: 传统适配体发现依赖指数富集配体系统进化技术（SELEX），常受到文库容量有限、PCR偏差和多轮筛选的制约。摘要将AI与适配体开发的结合，概括为从经验筛选向理性、数据驱动设计的转变。

paragraphs: 综述首先讨论生物信息学数据库及高通量SELEX数据分析工具，随后梳理二级、三级结构预测策略，包括AlphaFold 3、RoseTTAFoldNA和基于扩散的方法。摘要还列出适配体—靶标相互作用预测的机器学习方法，以及分子对接、动力学模拟和自由能计算。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Machine Learning for Joint Fault Diagnosis in Inverter-Fed Induction Motor Drives
papers.abstract: In intelligent electric vehicle (EV) traction drives, pulse-width modulation and field-oriented control (FOC) introduce broadband harmonics and non-stationary start-up transients. These dynamics obscure incipient inter-turn stator faults (ITSF), particularly when inverter switch failures and measurement interference co-occur. To meet the low-latency requirements of on-board vehicle control units (VCUs), this paper proposes a data-centric, physics-guided diagnosis pipeline. Relying exclusively on current measurements, the framework jointly detects and localises ITSF (1–3% severity), open-circuit IGBT faults, and additive white Gaussian noise (5–20 dB SNR). A compact 27-dimensional feature vector is constructed by fusing db4 discrete wavelet transform sub-band energies, residualised negative-sequence phasors, αβ hodograph descriptors, and harmonic energy ratios. This targeted extraction empowers an ensemble of bagged decision trees to perform lightweight classification suitable for embedded edge hardware. In a simulation-based evaluation across four scenarios (transient and steady state, with and without AWGN), the pipeline achieves cross-validated accuracies of 91.63–98.97% and hold-out test accuracies of 93.13–98.75%. Unlike traditional threshold detectors that conflate inverter or sensing artefacts with ITSF, this approach achieves subsystem-level localisation across motor, inverter, and sensing hardware, providing the reliable condition monitoring required for cyber–physical EV digital twins.

raw_metadata.title: Physics-Guided Machine Learning for Joint Fault Diagnosis in Inverter-Fed Induction Motor Drives
raw_metadata.abstract: In intelligent electric vehicle (EV) traction drives, pulse-width modulation and field-oriented control (FOC) introduce broadband harmonics and non-stationary start-up transients. These dynamics obscure incipient inter-turn stator faults (ITSF), particularly when inverter switch failures and measurement interference co-occur. To meet the low-latency requirements of on-board vehicle control units (VCUs), this paper proposes a data-centric, physics-guided diagnosis pipeline. Relying exclusively on current measurements, the framework jointly detects and localises ITSF (1–3% severity), open-circuit IGBT faults, and additive white Gaussian noise (5–20 dB SNR). A compact 27-dimensional feature vector is constructed by fusing db4 discrete wavelet transform sub-band energies, residualised negative-sequence phasors, αβ hodograph descriptors, and harmonic energy ratios. This targeted extraction empowers an ensemble of bagged decision trees to perform lightweight classification suitable for embedded edge hardware. In a simulation-based evaluation across four scenarios (transient and steady state, with and without AWGN), the pipeline achieves cross-validated accuracies of 91.63–98.97% and hold-out test accuracies of 93.13–98.75%. Unlike traditional threshold detectors that conflate inverter or sensing artefacts with ITSF, this approach achieves subsystem-level localisation across motor, inverter, and sensing hardware, providing the reliable condition monitoring required for cyber–physical EV digital twins.

raw_metadata.title_zh: 物理引导机器学习用于逆变器供电感应电机驱动系统的联合故障诊断

article.lead: 电动车牵引驱动中的早期电机故障，可能被控制谐波、启动瞬态和测量干扰掩盖。这项研究探索仅凭电流测量，联合识别并定位电机、逆变器与传感环节的异常，阅读价值在于理解如何用物理特征支撑轻量诊断。

sections.title: 电流异常，未必来自电机本身
paragraphs: 在智能电动车牵引驱动中，脉宽调制与磁场定向控制（FOC）会引入宽带谐波和非平稳启动瞬态，掩盖早期定子匝间故障（ITSF）。当逆变器开关故障与测量干扰同时出现时，异常来源更难区分。
因此，研究关注的不只是“有没有故障”，还包括异常属于哪个子系统。同时，面向车载控制单元的低延迟要求，诊断流程也需要兼顾计算负担。

sections.title: 以物理特征组织电流，再交给袋装决策树
paragraphs: 作者提出以数据为中心、物理引导的诊断流程，仅使用电流测量，联合检测并定位严重程度为1–3%的ITSF、IGBT开路故障，以及信噪比为5–20 dB的加性白高斯噪声（AWGN）。
方法将db4离散小波变换子带能量、残差化负序相量、αβ轨迹描述符和谐波能量比融合为27维特征向量，再由袋装决策树集成完成分类。其设计目标是以针对性的特征提取支持适用于嵌入式边缘硬件的轻量分类。

sections.title: 仿真报告了分类准确率与子系统定位
paragraphs: 摘要报告的评价基于仿真，覆盖瞬态与稳态、含与不含AWGN的四种场景。交叉验证准确率为91.63–98.97%，留出测试准确率为93.13–98.75%。这些范围对应摘要所述评价场景，不宜视为所有实际工况下的性能保证。
作者报告，该方法能够在电机、逆变器和传感硬件之间实现子系统级定位，并将其与容易混淆逆变器或传感伪影和ITSF的传统阈值检测器作对照。摘要未给出这一对照的具体性能差值。

sections.title: 仿真准确率尚不能回答车载部署问题
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断样本数量、类别分布、训练与测试划分方式，也无法确认不同场景间是否存在共享数据。摘要同样未展开传统阈值检测器的配置及逐类比较结果，因此不能据此完整评价泛化能力与比较公平性。
摘要未报告实机或实车验证、硬件推理延迟和资源占用，也未说明各类异常的误报与漏报情况。这不等于论文没有开展相关工作，但现有资料不足以确认车载低延迟部署效果；服务电动车数字孪生的用途也不应直接理解为已完成系统验证。

sections.title: 阅读启发：先问异常来源，再看总体准确率
paragraphs: 阅读启发：这项工作值得关注的是，如何在同一电流信号中区分电机故障、逆变器故障与测量干扰。进一步阅读时，可重点核对各类异常的混淆情况、物理特征的具体作用，以及轻量分类与实际运行延迟之间的证据，避免仅凭总体准确率判断运维价值。

papers.title: From preventive to predictive maintenance : application and comparison of machine learning models
papers.abstract: Η παρούσα εργασία εξετάζει την εξέλιξη της συντήρησης του βιομηχανικού εξοπλισμού από τις παραδοσιακές στρατηγικές προς την προγνωστική συντήρηση. Αρχικά παρουσιάζονται η διορθωτική, η προληπτική, η βάσει κατάστασης και η προγνωστική συντήρηση καθώς και ο ρόλος των λειτουργικών δεδομένων, των αισθητήρων και της παρακολούθησης κατάστασης.Στη συνέχεια εξετάζεται η χρήση της Μηχανικής Μάθησης για την αναγνώριση βλαβών και παρουσιάζονται η Λογιστική Παλινδρόμηση, το Δέντρο Απόφασης, το Τυχαίο Δάσος και το Πολυεπίπεδο Perceptron. Στο εφαρμοσμένο μέρος χρησιμοποιείται το συνθετικό σύνολο δεδομένων AI4I 2020. Η αρχική εξέταση έδειξε ότι το dataset έχει καθαρή και οργανωμένη δομή αλλά παρουσιάζει έντονη ανισορροπία, καθώς μόνο το 3.39% των παρατηρήσεων αντιστοιχεί σε βλάβη. Μετά την κατάλληλη προεπεξεργασία, τα τέσσερα μοντέλαεκπαιδεύτηκαν και αξιολογήθηκαν στο ίδιο σύνολο δοκιμής. Τα αποτελέσματα έδειξαν διαφορετική συμπεριφορά μεταξύ των μοντέλων. Το Τυχαίο Δάσος παρουσίασε την υψηλότερη precision, τον μεγαλύτερο δείκτη F1 και το υψηλότερο PR-AUC. Αντίθετα, το Πολυεπίπεδο Perceptron παρουσίασε την υψηλότερη ανάκληση και το υψηλότερο ROC-AUC, εντοπίζοντας 61 από τις 68 πραγματικές βλάβες. Συνολικά, η εργασία δείχνει ότι η επιλογή ενός μοντέλου προγνωστικής συντήρησης πρέπει να λαμβάνει υπόψη τόσο την ικανότητα ανίχνευσης βλαβών όσο και τον αριθμό των ψευδών συναγερμών.
papers.summary: 本文围绕工业设备由传统维护转向预测性维护，介绍维护策略及运行数据、传感器和状态监测的作用，并在合成数据集AI4I 2020上比较四类机器学习模型。故障观测仅占3.39%，类别明显不平衡。随机森林在精确率、F1和PR-AUC上表现最佳，多层感知机则在召回率和ROC-AUC上领先，检出68次真实故障中的61次。核心启示是模型选择需兼顾故障检出与误报，而非追求单一指标。[摘要]

raw_metadata.title_zh: 从预防性维护到预测性维护：机器学习模型的应用与比较

article.lead: 工业设备从预防性维护走向预测性维护，关键不只是识别故障，还要兼顾误报。这项研究在同一测试集上比较四种机器学习模型，展示了不同评价指标可能指向不同的模型选择。

sections.title: 从维护策略转向故障识别问题
paragraphs: 研究围绕工业设备维护策略的演进展开，介绍了纠正性维护、预防性维护、基于状态的维护与预测性维护，并讨论运行数据、传感器和状态监测的作用。其应用部分将关注点落在机器学习如何识别故障，而不是仅对维护策略作概念介绍。

sections.title: 在合成数据上比较四种分类模型
paragraphs: 研究使用AI4I 2020合成数据集，比较逻辑回归、决策树、随机森林和多层感知机。摘要指出，数据结构整洁、有序，但类别明显不平衡：仅有3.39%的观测对应故障。经过预处理后，四种模型完成训练，并在同一测试集上接受评估。
摘要明确给出了数据来源、候选模型和共同测试集，但没有展开预处理的具体步骤。因此，当前能够确认的是比较框架，不能进一步推断其是否采用重采样、特征筛选或特定的数据划分方式。

sections.title: 随机森林与多层感知机各有指标优势
paragraphs: 随机森林取得了最高的精确率（precision）、F1和PR-AUC；多层感知机则取得了最高的召回率和ROC-AUC，并识别出68个实际故障中的61个。**不同指标下的领先模型并不相同**，这是摘要报告的核心比较结果。
研究据此强调，预测性维护模型的选择需要同时考虑故障检出能力和误报数量。摘要没有给出全部指标的具体数值，也未说明逻辑回归与决策树的详细表现，因此不能据此补出完整排名，或认定某个模型在所有方面都更优。

sections.title: 合成数据结果尚不能说明现场适用范围
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断总样本量、训练与测试的划分比例、超参数设置，以及结果是否经过重复评估。虽然测试集中的实际故障数量已有报告，但完整的样本构成与比较条件仍不清楚。
应用数据被明确标为合成数据；摘要未交代真实设备现场验证、跨设备或跨工况比较，也未说明故障识别是否具有提前预警能力。这些属于当前资料无法判断的验证范围，不代表论文没有开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：把指标差异放回维护决策
paragraphs: 阅读启发：后续阅读可优先关注作者如何解释漏检与误报之间的取舍，以及模型判定阈值如何确定。对于这项故障占比较低的比较，值得追问的不是简单选出一个“最好模型”，而是各项指标优势对应什么样的维护需求，以及这些结论能在何种数据条件下成立。

papers.title: Fatigue characterization of hybrid fibre-reinforced concrete: S-N curve development, Weibull reliability modelling, and effect of variable amplitude loading
papers.abstract: Fatigue loading is a primary factor governing the durability and service life of structural concrete, necessitating materials with enhanced resistance to cyclic degradation. This study presents a detailed fatigue characterization of concrete prisms incorporating mono and hybrid fibre reinforcements under constant and variable amplitude flexural loading. Seven mixtures were investigated: normal concrete (NC), steel fibre -reinforced concrete (SFRC) at 0.5%, 1.0%, and 1.5% volume fractions, and hybrid steel-polypropylene fibre-reinforced concrete (SF-PPF: 75: 25) in each volume fraction. Fatigue stress levels were decided based static flexural tests. Constant-amplitude fatigue tests were conducted at stress levels of 0.6–0.9 (stress ratio 0.1; 5 Hz), to construct S-N curve. It was observed from the extensive experiments that the synergetic effect of fibre reinforcement significantly improved fatigue performance by enhancing crack-bridging capacity, delaying crack propagation, and improving stiffness retention. Fatigue life decreased with increasing stress levels across all mixes; however, hybrid composites, exhibited substantially extended fatigue life. The S-N relationship was effectively described using the Basquin model, demonstrating strong agreement with experimental results. Probabilistic fatigue behaviour was evaluated using a two-parameter Weibull distribution, indicating reduced scatter and improved reliability for fibre-reinforced concretes compared to NC. Among all mixtures, the 1.5% hybrid fibre mix exhibited the highest fatigue life and improved damage resistance under cyclic loading conditions, whereas the 1.0% hybrid mix demonstrated comparatively lower fatigue-life scatter and better statistical reliability based on Weibull analysis. Overall, the optimal comprehensive performance was achieved through a balanced combination of fatigue durability and reliability characteristics.
papers.summary: 本文围绕混杂纤维混凝土的抗疲劳能力与寿命可靠性开展研究，比较普通混凝土、钢纤维混凝土及钢—聚丙烯混杂纤维混凝土七种配合比。研究结合弯曲疲劳试验、Basquin模型和两参数Weibull分布，分别描述应力—寿命关系与寿命离散性。摘要报告，1.5%混杂纤维组疲劳寿命最高，1.0%组则呈现更低离散性和更好的统计可靠性。其阅读价值在于区分寿命提升与可靠性改善，但摘要不足以核查变幅加载效果和模型精度。[摘要]

article.lead: 混杂纤维能否让混凝土既承受更多次循环荷载，又表现出更稳定的疲劳寿命？这项研究将疲劳寿命与统计可靠性并列考察，提示“寿命最高”和“离散性较低”未必对应同一种配比。

sections.title: 抗疲劳不只看寿命，也要看离散性
paragraphs: 疲劳荷载是影响结构混凝土耐久性与服役寿命的重要因素。针对循环作用下的性能退化，研究比较普通混凝土、单一钢纤维混凝土与钢—聚丙烯混杂纤维混凝土，关注纤维增强能否改善抗疲劳表现。
本文依据完整摘要解读。研究同时采用寿命曲线与概率分布描述疲劳行为，因此阅读重点不仅是材料能够承受多少次循环，还包括寿命结果是否更集中、统计可靠性如何变化。

sections.title: 弯曲疲劳试验结合两类寿命模型
paragraphs: 研究考察七种混合料：普通混凝土，以及纤维体积分数分别为0.5%、1.0%和1.5%的钢纤维混凝土与混杂纤维混凝土。混杂体系采用钢纤维和聚丙烯纤维，摘要给出的配比为75:25。
研究对象为混凝土棱柱体，涉及恒幅与变幅弯曲加载。疲劳应力水平依据静态弯曲试验确定；恒幅试验的应力水平为0.6–0.9，应力比为0.1，频率为5 Hz。作者据此建立S-N曲线，以Basquin模型描述应力—寿命关系，并采用双参数Weibull分布分析概率疲劳行为。

sections.title: 混杂纤维的寿命优势与可靠性差异
paragraphs: 摘要报告，所有混合料的疲劳寿命均随应力水平升高而降低，但混杂纤维材料表现出明显延长的疲劳寿命。作者将纤维的协同增强作用与裂缝桥联能力增强、裂缝扩展延缓及刚度保持改善联系起来。
Basquin模型与试验结果吻合良好；Weibull分析表明，与普通混凝土相比，纤维混凝土的寿命离散性降低、可靠性改善。其中，1.5%混杂纤维组具有最高疲劳寿命，并表现出改善的循环损伤抵抗能力；1.0%混杂纤维组则呈现相对较低的寿命离散性和较好的统计可靠性。**寿命最高与统计表现更稳定，应分开理解。**

sections.title: 摘要尚不能界定的验证范围
paragraphs: 摘要未报告各组试件数量、重复试验安排、具体寿命数据、模型参数或拟合评价指标，因此无法仅据摘要判断寿命增益幅度、组间差异的统计显著性，以及可靠性估计的不确定性。
虽然研究涉及变幅加载，但摘要未交代加载序列及其独立比较结果，也未说明模型在其他工况中的验证范围。这些属于当前资料无法判断的内容，不能据此认定论文没有开展相关工作；摘要也未明确指定综合性能最优的唯一配比。

sections.title: 阅读启发：把寿命水平与可靠性并排看
paragraphs: 阅读启发：后续阅读原文时，可重点核对不同配比的寿命分布、Weibull参数及其不确定性，理解为何最高寿命与较低离散性分别出现在不同混杂纤维组。另一个值得追问的问题是：变幅加载是否改变了这些比较关系？这些是摘要引出的阅读方向，而不是已经得到验证的工程选材结论。

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Predictive and Prescriptive Maintenance for Induced Draft Fan in Steam Power Plant
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: The Induced Draft (ID) Fan at the case-study unit has no installed redundancy. If it fails, the unit is derated by up to 50% or tripped by a Master Fuel Trip. Route-based monitoring finds damage late, because early vibration amplitudes sit below the ISO 10816 threshold. We treated this as a DMAIC problem, fishbone analysis and a Cost-Benefit screen ranked an explainable autodetection layer above analyst training and material fixes. The detector is a 135,750-parameter one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) whose layers follow a Digital Signal Processing (DSP) equivalence (convolution as FIR filtering, max-pooling as envelope demodulation, stacked layers as Zoom-FFT), so an engineer can check its decisions against physics. SHAP attributions are mapped to the frequency and cyclic-spectral domains (CS-SHAP). Run-to-failure data could not be obtained from the plant, and MAFAULDA (50 kHz, 97,550 segments) was used as a surrogate for ID Fan fault modes. With a leakage-safe file-level split (1,560 training, 391 test files), accuracy reached 99% and macro-F1 0.99 over six machine conditions, above the 90% Critical-to-Quality target. CS-SHAP energy clustered on the resonance carrier near f ~ 2 kHz around the BPFO and BPFI markers, as DSP theory predicts. The improvement becomes a condition-based SOP with three-tier early warning and a model-drift control plan. By converting the single annual unplanned event into scheduled work, it targets an MTTR reduction from 120 to 72 hours or 40%,against an estimated IDR 5.70 billion per unplanned event and is projected to reduce ID Fan EFOR from 0.29% toward 0%.

papers.title: How the Classical Baseline Shapes Machine-Learning Speed Claims in Topology Optimization
papers.abstract: Topology optimization places material in a design domain to optimize a structure's performance, such as its stiffness or heat conduction. Machine-learning methods often report large speed-ups over classical, non-learned optimization, but a slow classical code or a lower-quality learned design can exaggerate them. We re-ran released code for eight methods on one workstation and studied two in depth: Optimize Any Topology (OAT), a diffusion model that generates designs, and a graph-based neural optimizer. Replacing the classical code with an efficient implementation of the same algorithm cut these two methods' speed-ups by up to 20-fold. We then timed the classical code until its design was at least as stiff as the learned one; for OAT, we picked this point after the runs, which gives the classical code its best case. Published timings imply a 134x speed-up for OAT on a 256 x 256 grid; our matched single-design comparisons gave 1.5x to 3.5x. At matched stiffness, the graph-based optimizer was slower than the classical code in all six two-dimensional problems. Of the six other methods, two kept their advantage, one shrank, one reversed, and two were not comparable. In an exploratory audit, language models judged that 8 of 28 speed comparisons in randomly sampled, openly accessible articles lacked evidence of equal design quality; our own review counted 11, so the count depends on who judges. We provide a comparison procedure and a minimum report: classical code, hardware, design quality, what each timing includes, and data-generation and training costs.

raw_metadata.title: How the Classical Baseline Shapes Machine-Learning Speed Claims in Topology Optimization
raw_metadata.abstract: Topology optimization places material so that a structure resists deformation under given loads. Machine-learning methods often report large speed-ups over classical, non-learned optimization, but a slow classical code or a less stiff learned design can exaggerate them. We re-ran released code for eight methods on one workstation and studied two in depth: Optimize Any Topology (OAT), a diffusion model that generates designs, and a graph-based neural optimizer. Speeding up only the classical code's finite-element solver cut these two methods' speed-ups by up to 20-fold. We then timed the classical code until its design was at least as stiff as the learned one; for OAT, we read this point off the completed runs. Published timings imply a 134x speed-up for OAT on a 256 x 256 grid; our matched single-design comparisons gave 1.5x to 3.5x. At matched stiffness, the graph-based optimizer was slower than the classical code in all six two-dimensional problems. Of the six other methods, two kept their advantage, one shrank, one reversed and two were not comparable. In an exploratory audit of published claims, language models judged that 8 of 28 speed comparisons in randomly sampled, openly accessible articles lacked evidence of equal design quality; our own review counted 11, so the count depends on who judges. We provide a comparison procedure and a minimum report: classical code, hardware, design quality, what each timing includes, and data-generation and training costs.

raw_metadata.title_zh: 经典基线如何影响拓扑优化中的机器学习加速宣称

article.lead: 机器学习做拓扑优化，到底快在算法，还是快在比较口径？这项研究通过重跑公开代码、加速经典求解器并对齐设计刚度，说明一个关键问题：**加速比既取决于学习方法，也取决于经典基线和设计质量是否公平可比。**

sections.title: 速度比较之前，先问结构是否同样抗变形
paragraphs: 拓扑优化通过布置材料，让结构抵抗给定载荷下的变形。机器学习方法常报告相对经典非学习优化的大幅加速，但如果经典代码本身较慢，或者学习方法生成的设计刚度较低，加速比就可能被夸大。本文关注的不是单纯缩短运行时间，而是速度优势是否建立在可比的设计质量之上。

sections.title: 重跑公开代码，再按刚度对齐计时
paragraphs: 作者在同一工作站上重跑了八种方法的公开代码，重点研究生成设计的扩散模型 Optimize Any Topology（OAT）和一种基于图的神经优化器。他们先仅加速经典代码中的有限元求解器，再考察经典设计达到不低于学习设计刚度时所需的时间；其中，OAT 的对应时点是从已完成的运行中读取的。

sections.title: 更强的经典基线，让部分加速优势明显收缩
paragraphs: 仅加速经典代码的有限元求解器，就使上述两种方法的加速比最多缩减20倍。已发表的计时意味着 OAT 在256 × 256网格上有134倍加速，而作者对齐条件后的单设计比较得到1.5至3.5倍加速。在刚度匹配时，图神经优化器在全部六个二维问题上都慢于经典代码。
其余六种方法中，两种保留优势，一种优势缩小，一种优劣逆转，两种无法比较。探索性文献审查也显示判断存在差异：对随机抽取的开放可访问文章中的28项速度比较，语言模型认为8项缺少设计质量相等的证据，作者自行审查则计为11项。这些计数反映证据判断差异，不能直接等同于方法失效的数量。
作者还提出比较流程与最低报告要求，包括经典代码、硬件、设计质量、计时包含哪些环节，以及数据生成和训练成本，使速度主张有更清楚的比较口径。

sections.title: 摘要能说明比较敏感性，不能界定全部适用范围
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断各方法的具体载荷、边界条件、设计样本规模、重复运行与波动情况，也无法核对刚度评价细节，以及两种方法不可比较的具体原因。摘要没有展开其他问题类型或更广泛验证的范围，不能据此断言论文未做相关分析，也不能把当前结果推广为所有学习方法都没有速度优势。

sections.title: 阅读启发：把加速比拆成可核对的比较条件
paragraphs: 阅读启发：评估结构生成式设计的速度主张时，建议先追问经典基线是否充分优化、双方是否达到相当刚度、计时是否覆盖相同环节，再看加速倍数。进一步阅读可关注数据生成与训练成本如何报告，以及比较结论对设计质量判据有多敏感；这些是理解本文结果的方向，而不是本文已经验证的额外结论。
