papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Techniques for Fatigue Performance Prediction in Metal Additive Manufacturing: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Metal additive manufacturing (AM) has revolutionized the design and production landscape for critical sectors, including aerospace, automotive, and energy. It enables the production of lightweight, topology-optimized, and functionally graded components that are impractical to produce through conventional manufacturing methods. However, the widespread adoption of AM parts in load-bearing applications remains constrained by their limited and variable fatigue performance, strongly influenced by process-induced defects (e.g., porosity, lack of fusion), microstructural anisotropy, surface conditions, and post-processing treatments. In recent years, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) have emerged as powerful tools for modeling complex process–structure–property–performance relationships and predicting fatigue life, strength, and crack growth in metal AM systems. This study presents a comprehensive PRISMA-guided systematic review of peer-reviewed publications that apply AI and ML for fatigue prediction in metallic AM components. The review synthesizes modeling approaches ranging from conventional “shallow” learners, such as support vector machines (SVM), random forests (RF), and XGBoost, to advanced deep learning frameworks, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). We categorize existing studies based on their input data modalities, including defect-sensitive models that utilize XCT or SEM data, microstructure-aware models that leverage crystallographic features, and hybrid surrogates that integrate process, structure, and property information. Furthermore, we highlight strategies to address data scarcity, including transfer learning, synthetic data augmentation, and cross-validation. Key research gaps are identified in the areas of dataset standardization, physics integration, uncertainty quantification, and cross-material generalization. Finally, the review outlines emerging directions for developing physically grounded, interpretable, and generalizable AI frameworks capable of reliable fatigue performance prediction across diverse AM materials and platforms.

raw_metadata.title_zh: 金属增材制造疲劳性能预测的人工智能技术：系统综述

article.lead: 金属增材制造能实现复杂轻量化构件，但疲劳性能有限且波动，仍制约其承载应用。这篇系统综述梳理人工智能如何预测疲劳寿命、强度与裂纹扩展，阅读价值在于理解模型依赖什么数据，以及可靠预测还面临哪些障碍。

sections.title: 复杂构件的制造优势，遇上疲劳性能波动
paragraphs: 金属增材制造为航空航天、汽车和能源领域提供了轻量化、拓扑优化及功能梯度构件的制造可能。然而，制造出复杂形状并不意味着疲劳性能自然可靠：孔隙、未熔合等工艺诱发缺陷，以及微观组织各向异性、表面状态和后处理，都会影响疲劳表现。
这也是人工智能与机器学习受到关注的背景。相关建模试图连接复杂的“工艺—组织—性能—服役表现”关系，预测对象不仅包括疲劳寿命，也包括疲劳强度和裂纹扩展。

sections.title: 按模型类型与输入数据整理既有研究
paragraphs: 作者开展了遵循PRISMA指导的系统综述，整理将人工智能与机器学习用于金属增材制造疲劳预测的同行评议文献。综述覆盖支持向量机、随机森林、XGBoost等传统“浅层”学习方法，也纳入卷积神经网络和物理信息神经网络。
另一条整理线索是输入数据：包括使用XCT或SEM数据的缺陷敏感模型、利用晶体学特征的微观组织感知模型，以及整合工艺、组织与性能信息的混合代理模型。摘要还将迁移学习、合成数据增强和交叉验证列为应对数据稀缺的相关策略。

sections.title: 综述指出的关键缺口，不只是算法选择
paragraphs: 摘要报告的主要认识，是该领域仍存在数据集标准化、物理融合、不确定性量化和跨材料泛化方面的研究缺口。这些问题说明，作者关注的不只是模型形式，还包括数据能否一致组织、预测能否体现物理依据，以及模型能否迁移到不同材料。
综述进一步提出，应发展具有物理基础、可解释性和泛化能力的人工智能框架，以面向不同增材制造材料与平台开展可靠疲劳预测。**这是作者提出的发展方向，不是摘要已经证明实现的效果。**

sections.title: 摘要尚不足以判断预测精度与验证边界
paragraphs: 本解读仅依据完整摘要。摘要未给出纳入文献数量、检索与筛选细节，也未列出各研究的样本规模、材料和工艺覆盖范围，因此无法据此判断综述覆盖程度或具体模型的数据基础。
摘要也未报告统一的模型比较结果、误差指标及外部验证范围，不能据此认定深度学习优于传统模型，或认定某类方法已具备跨材料可靠性。这些属于当前资料无法判断的内容，不代表论文没有讨论。

sections.title: 阅读启发：先看数据与验证，再看模型名称
paragraphs: 阅读启发：进一步阅读时，可围绕摘要指出的缺口追问：不同研究的数据是否可比，物理信息如何进入模型，不确定性如何表达，跨材料泛化又由什么验证支持。对关注结构疲劳与可靠性的读者，这些问题比单看算法名称更有助于理解预测结果的适用边界。

papers.title: A Review of Fault Diagnosis Methods for Turnout Switch Machines
papers.venue: DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals)
papers.abstract: ObjectiveThe intelligent upgrade of railway electrical maintenance system has raised new demands for the fault diagnosis technology of turnout switch machines. Therefore，it is necessary to systematically evaluate the application and development paths of various methods in this field. MethodA multi-dimensional technical analysis of relevant methods and achievements is conducted to reveal the technical characteristics and bottlenecks of current machine learning-driven fault diagnosis systems. Addressing the current research status and taking the ZD6 and S700K switch machines as examples，common fault types of both DC （direct current） and AC （alternating current） switch machines are summarized，and the shortcomings of existing case databases regarding data comprehensiveness and fault category coverage are pointed out. In terms of feature extraction，targeting the data characteristics of switch machine action curves，the methods and challenges of fault feature extraction are reviewed，and the effectiveness of feature processing strategies across different dimensions is discussed. Furthermore，the primary applied algorithms in fault diagnosis are detailed，including typical application cases of support vector machines，neural networks，and cutting-edge algorithms，with a focus on analyzing the performance and applicable scenarios of each algorithm. Result & Conclusion Deep learning methods have strongly facilitated the improvement of fault diagnosis capabilities for turnout switch machines，leading to significant enhancements in both accuracy and diagnostic efficiency. Based on certain deficiencies in existing research，potential future research directions are proposed from the data，methodology，and engineering application levels. This provides a theoretical basis and technical pathway for the engineering deployment of intelligent diagnostic systems，thereby promoting the intellectualization and practical upgrade of fault diagnosis for turnout switch machines.

papers.title: Financial-risk aware machine learning for industrial anomaly detection
papers.venue: Journal of Green Economy and Optimization Research
papers.abstract: Digital transformation in asset-intensive industries is constrained by the separation between Information Technology (IT), which supports enterprise decision-making, and Operational Technology (OT), which monitors and controls physical assets. This study proposes a Financial-Risk Aware Digital Twin framework that combines machine-learning-based anomaly detection with event-specific economic consequence analysis. Using the benchmark 3W oil and gas dataset, an XGBoost classifier was developed to identify operational states including severe slugging, spurious Downhole Safety Valve closure, flow instability, productivity loss, scaling, and hydrate formation. The model achieved 93% overall accuracy, with weighted-average precision and F1-score of 0.94 and 0.93, respectively. Predicted class probabilities were then converted into class-specific expected financial exposure using illustrative consequence scenarios. At a predicted probability of 20%, the corresponding exposure was $200,000 for hydrate formation, $100,000 for DHSV closure, and $10,000–$20,000 for one day of severe slugging under the selected scenario assumptions. Financial weighting also changed event prioritization in an illustrative re-ranking example. For hydrate formation, a base-case failure consequence of $1,000,000 and preventive-action cost of $5,000 produced a 0.5% break-even intervention probability; sensitivity analysis across alternative assumptions yielded thresholds from 0.125% to 2.0%. The results show how probabilistic condition monitoring can be extended into an economically informed decision-support framework that prioritizes operational responses according to both likelihood and consequence.

papers.title: A Heterogeneous Multi-Modal Parallel Deep Learning Framework for Multiaxial Fatigue Life Prediction of Metals
papers.abstract: Multiaxial fatigue damage remains a critical barrier to the reliable design of metallic engineering components, particularly under complex non-proportional loading paths. Conventional critical-plane and energy-based models rely heavily on empirical assumptions and struggle to capture intricate path-dependent damage evolution, leading to limited accuracy and generalizability. To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel data-driven framework that integrates heterogeneous information sources through a three-branch parallel neural architecture. Specifically, a deep neural network (DNN) extracts static material intrinsic properties; a bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BiGRU) enhanced with a multi-head self-attention mechanism captures long-term temporal dependencies and adaptively weights key stages in loading histories; and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) extracts local strain fluctuation patterns. The three streams are fused to produce a comprehensive damage representation for end-to-end life prediction. The output of the model is the base −10 logarithm of fatigue life, i.e., lg(Nf). Evaluated on a public multiaxial fatigue dataset comprising 40 metals and 1167 samples, the proposed model achieves a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.9052, achieving promising performance on a fixed data split (R2 = 0.9052); ablation studies demonstrate the complementary nature of the three feature extraction branches, though 5-fold cross-validation suggests that the performance gain requires further validation with larger datasets. Systematic ablation studies confirm that the multi-source fusion strategy and the attention mechanism are pivotal to the performance gain. This work offers a robust and effective data-driven solution for high-accuracy fatigue life assessment, and points toward future integration of physical knowledge to further enhance extrapolation and transparency.
papers.summary: 本文针对复杂非比例载荷下金属多轴疲劳寿命预测，提出融合材料属性、载荷历史与局部应变模式的三分支网络，输出lg(Nf)。摘要报告，模型在包含40种金属、1167个样本的公开数据集固定划分上取得R2为0.9052；消融支持分支互补及注意力机制作用，但五折交叉验证提示性能增益仍需更大数据集验证。[摘要] 本次仅作摘要级解读，适合关注疲劳可靠性与数据驱动寿命评估的读者。

deep_read.problem: 研究问题是复杂非比例加载下的多轴疲劳寿命预测。摘要指出传统临界平面与能量模型依赖经验假设，难以刻画路径相关损伤演化，原文称“path-dependent damage evolution”。[摘要] 解读：关键挑战不仅是拟合寿命，还包括表达不同加载路径带来的损伤差异。
deep_read.method: 方法采用“three-branch parallel neural architecture”：DNN提取材料固有属性，带多头自注意力的BiGRU处理载荷历史长期依赖，1D-CNN提取局部应变波动；三路融合后输出lg(Nf)。[摘要] 摘要未给出网络规模、损失函数和训练配置，尚不能据此复现。
deep_read.innovation: 摘要所述方法特色是将材料静态信息、载荷时间依赖和局部应变模式交由不同网络处理，再融合为损伤表征，原文称“comprehensive damage representation”。[摘要] 解读：值得关注的是异构信息的互补组织方式；缺少全文及相关工作对比，无法确认其首创性。
deep_read.findings: 摘要报告公开数据集包含40种金属、1167个样本，固定划分取得R2为0.9052，并称消融显示三分支互补，融合与注意力机制对性能增益重要。[摘要] 其证据同时包含限定语“on a fixed data split”；未提供各消融数值，不能量化单个模块的贡献。
deep_read.limitations: 摘要明确指出五折交叉验证提示性能增益“requires further validation with larger datasets”。[摘要] 因此现有结果不能直接证明跨数据划分的稳定优势。当前资料未给出各折指标、划分规则和外推测试，无法判断波动幅度或是否存在数据泄漏；这属于证据缺口，而非已证实缺陷。
deep_read.connection: 解读：模型直接预测金属多轴疲劳寿命，与结构设计中的寿命评估和疲劳可靠性方向紧密相关；摘要定位为“fatigue life assessment”。[摘要] 对智能运维，其载荷历史建模可提供方法参考，但资料未报告在线监测、剩余寿命更新或失效概率估计，不能将这些视为已有成果。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议：阅读全文时优先核查数据划分、五折结果、基线公平性及消融配置，再考虑按材料或加载路径留出测试。作者提出未来融合物理知识以改善“extrapolation and transparency”。[摘要] 建议将物理约束和预测不确定性作为后续研究方向，而非认定论文已实现相关能力。

article.lead: 复杂非比例载荷下，金属多轴疲劳损伤难以可靠预测。本文摘要介绍了一种并行融合材料属性、加载历史与应变波动信息的深度学习框架，并报告了其在公开数据集上的评估结果。

sections.title: 非比例载荷下的路径依赖损伤难题
paragraphs: 多轴疲劳是金属工程构件可靠设计面临的挑战之一，尤其在复杂非比例加载路径下，损伤演化具有路径依赖性。摘要指出，传统临界面和基于能量的模型较依赖经验假设，捕捉这类演化时面临困难，准确性与泛化能力因此受限。

sections.title: 三路并行提取异质信息
paragraphs: 框架由三个并行分支组成：深度神经网络（DNN）提取材料静态内在属性；加入多头自注意力机制的双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）捕捉加载历史中的长期时间依赖，并自适应赋予关键阶段权重；一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）提取局部应变波动模式。三路特征融合为损伤表征，用于端到端疲劳寿命预测；模型输出为疲劳寿命的以 −10 为底的对数 lg(Nf)。

sections.title: 固定划分表现与消融提示
paragraphs: 在包含40种金属、1167个样本的公开多轴疲劳数据集上，摘要报告模型在固定数据划分上的决定系数 R2 = 0.9052。消融研究显示三个特征提取分支具有互补性；摘要还指出，多源融合策略与注意力机制对性能提升起关键作用。
摘要提到的5折交叉验证提示，性能增益仍需在更大的数据集上进一步验证。因而，固定划分上的结果值得关注，但不能单凭摘要将其视为对更广泛材料或载荷情形的充分验证。

sections.title: 摘要未交代的评估边界
paragraphs: 摘要没有说明固定划分的具体构成、训练与测试样本如何划分，也未给出不同基线模型、各分支消融结果或5折交叉验证的详细数值。样本与载荷路径覆盖范围、独立外部验证情况及误差分布，也无法仅凭摘要判断；这表示摘要未报告这些细节，不代表论文没有进行相关分析。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注泛化与物理知识结合
paragraphs: **阅读启发：**进一步阅读时，可关注交叉验证和消融分析的具体设置与结果，以及模型面对不同材料、加载路径时的适用范围。摘要提出未来可整合物理知识，以增强外推能力与透明度；这些方向的实现方式和实际效果，摘要并未提供，需结合论文后续内容判断。

papers.title: Transfer learning framework for fatigue life prediction of additively manufactured parts
papers.abstract: Additive manufacturing has the potential to make things more efficient because of its ability to build customizable products quickly and with fewer resources required. The issue that additive manufacturing faces is the inferior performance relative to conventionally manufactured parts in the long run, thus hindering their adoption in mission-critical applications. The main cause of this inferior performance in as-built parts is surface roughness, which can not be avoided due to process physics. The deep valleys in the surface act as stress concentration areas that become crack initiation sites, thus leading to part failure. The scarcity of fatigue testing data compounds this problem, as fatigue tests are expensive in terms of time and cost. Transfer learning is a machine learning technique used to handle the problem of smaller datasets for training by leveraging the model learned for a related task and using it for the target task. This work aims to use the transfer learning technique and fatigue test data to build a framework that learns from the surface roughness data and makes predictions about fatigue life. This framework can potentially solve the data scarcity problem in studying the fatigue behavior of additively manufactured parts, thus facilitating their adoption in a wide spectrum of applications with confidence.
papers.summary: 增材制造零件的原始成形表面存在粗糙度，深谷可能成为应力集中与裂纹萌生位置，影响长期服役表现；疲劳试验耗时且昂贵，又限制了数据获取。[摘要] 本文拟利用迁移学习与疲劳试验数据，建立从表面粗糙度信息预测疲劳寿命的框架。其阅读价值在于把表面特征、寿命预测和小样本学习联系起来。当前仅有摘要，尚不能确认迁移策略、预测精度或实际可靠性收益，宜作为方法线索阅读，而非已验证的工程方案。

deep_read.problem: 本文关注增材制造零件长期性能不足与疲劳数据稀缺的双重问题。摘要称表面深谷会形成“stress concentration areas”，继而成为裂纹萌生位置；疲劳试验的时间和费用成本又限制了数据规模。[摘要] 解读：核心问题是如何在有限试验条件下建立表面状态与疲劳寿命之间的预测联系。
deep_read.method: 摘要提出结合迁移学习和疲劳试验数据，建立学习表面粗糙度信息并预测疲劳寿命的框架，目标表述为“makes predictions about fatigue life”。[摘要] 迁移学习被解释为利用相关任务所学模型服务目标任务，但源任务、模型结构、输入表征及迁移步骤均未说明，尚不能复现具体方法。
deep_read.innovation: 可识别的研究切入点，是把迁移学习用于增材制造零件的表面粗糙度—疲劳寿命预测，而非单纯增加疲劳试验数量。[摘要] 解读：这种组合具有应对小样本问题的方法探索价值，但摘要没有相关工作比较，也未说明独有算法设计，因此不能确认其首创性或相对既有方法的实质创新。
deep_read.findings: 当前摘要没有提供可核对的定量发现或模型对比结果，其结尾使用“can potentially solve”描述缓解数据稀缺问题的可能性。[摘要] 因此，可确认的是作者提出的研究目标及预期用途，而不是预测精度提升、试验需求下降或跨条件泛化已经得到验证；这些效果仍需进一步证据。

sections.title: 表面深谷与昂贵试验构成双重难题
paragraphs: 增材制造能够快速生产定制化产品，并具有减少资源需求的潜力。但摘要指出，相比传统制造零件，其长期服役表现仍限制着关键任务应用。作者将原始制造状态零件的性能问题主要归因于表面粗糙度：表面深谷形成应力集中区域，可能成为裂纹萌生位置，进而导致零件失效。

papers.title: ML-HCA coupled crashworthiness topology optimization method
papers.venue: International Conference on Mechanical Engineering, Materials and Automation Technology (MMEAT)
papers.abstract: The Hybrid Cellular Automata (HCA) algorithm is an effective tool for solving strongly nonlinear topology optimization problems in crash scenarios. However, its local rule-driven search mechanism has inherent limitations in utilizing global information. Meanwhile, Machine Learning (ML)-based surrogate modeling techniques have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities in structural optimization in recent years, offering new possibilities for global exploration within large design spaces. This paper proposes a serial–feedback coupled ML-HCA theoretical model. By fusing the element density fields generated during HCA iterations with global response information, a mapping from density fields to macroscopic performance is constructed, and the gradient information of the surrogate model is fed back to modify the local update rules of HCA. The theoretical foundations for constructing the coupled model are systematically analyzed, and theoretical comparisons are conducted with the conventional HCA method and purely data-driven methods. The analysis demonstrates that the ML-HCA coupled model, while maintaining physical consistency, can effectively mitigate the local optimum trap and reduce dependence on simulation data, thereby offering a novel perspective for the field of crashworthiness optimization.

papers.title: Cost-aware evaluation of uncertainty-guided neural operators for topology optimization
papers.venue: Samarra Journal of Engineering Science and Research
papers.abstract: Neural-operator predictions can replace some finite-element (FE) calculations in topology optimization, but its prediction errors can negatively affect the final design. This study tested whether model uncertainty helps to make a decision when FE calculations are needed. Seven policies were compared using Fourier neural operators to predict displacement on two 80 by 80 meshes, an L-bracket and a plate with a hole. Held-out displacement errors were 5.2% and 2.5%, respectively. Each setting was tested from 50 initial designs. Every final design was checked independently by FE analysis against a predefined unit-load stress limit. On the L-bracket, the method without FE corrections produced a mean peak stress 12.9 times the limit. Uncertainty gating with a fixed surrogate did not make all 50 designs feasible for all L-bracket tested settings. Retraining the surrogate during optimization achieved this target at a mean of 39.90 solves per design. Random timing reached the same target at an average of 43.76 solves across twelve independent schedules. On the plate with a hole, disagreement between ensemble predictions achieved the target at 27.26 solves, compared with 34.02 for random timing. At comparable budgets, it produced 50 feasible designs against 41 for the random control. Relative to full FE optimization, the cost of generating training labels was offset after approximately 100 L-bracket deployments and 87 plate deployments. These results showed that the benefit of uncertainty-guided timing differs between problems. Independent verification and a random-timing comparison are needed to assess that benefit.

papers.title: Industrial Predictive Maintenance Digital Twin System
papers.abstract: Abstract: Industrial predictive-maintenance digital twins require more than synchronized equipment replicas: they require inferential models that connect physical degradation, sensor measurements, interventions, operational decisions and institutional accountability. This monograph develops an integrated research architecture for machinery health monitoring and risk-aware maintenance in heterogeneous industrial environments. Its foundational layer specifies asset ontologies, degradation mechanisms, survival processes, uncertainty and validation evidence. A statistical layer addresses state estimation, hierarchical reliability, causal treatment effects and economic appraisal. A machine-learning layer examines multimodal signal representations, scarce-failure learning, remaining useful life, site transfer and human-interpretable assurance. The engineering layer establishes event-time telemetry contracts, reproducible feature pipelines, co-simulation, safe model releases and cyber-resilient operations. The applied layer connects sectoral deployment to service continuity, procurement, regional industrial capacity and prospective research programs. Ten cross-cutting themes synthesize the supplied reference corpus and connect disciplinary methods to implementation decisions. The proposed diagrams, equations, risk registers and protocols are conceptual research instruments intended for empirical specification and comparative assessment. Throughout, the analysis distinguishes predictive discrimination from intervention value, model fit from operational validity and automation from accountable authorization. The resulting design supports scientifically contestable and globally adaptable industrial twin systems that can be evaluated before consequential maintenance decisions are delegated. Keywords industrial digital twins, predictive maintenance, reliability engineering, asset ontology, fault diagnosis, condition monitoring, survival analysis, uncertainty quantification, causal inference, state estimation, industrial time series, multisensor fusion, remaining useful life, anomaly detection, domain adaptation, explainable AI, industrial IoT, stream processing, MLOps, co-simulation, cybersecurity, maintenance optimization, industrial governance

papers.title: Artifical Intelliegence And Machine Learning in Solid Dosage Formulation
authors: Pratik Patel*, Preeti Sah, Zahid Husain, Shivanshu Dwivedi, Rajveer Singh Chauhan, Nimita Manocha
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Solid dosage forms, tablets, capsules, pellets, and powders, remain the most widely manufactured medicines worldwide, yet their development has long relied on slow, trial-and-error experimentation that contributes to the 10–15 year, multi-billion-dollar cost of bringing a new drug to market. This review examines how artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are reshaping solid dosage formulation across its full lifecycle. The review surveys documented applications spanning pre-formulation screening, formulation design, manufacturing process control, dissolution and stability modeling, analytical method development, and emerging generative AI approaches, supported by published results demonstrating high predictive and detection accuracy. Real-world case studies, including Pfizer’s AI-assisted oral formulation work, a Merck convolutional neural network for tablet coating-defect detection, and autonomous formulation platforms such as Intrepid Labs, demonstrate that these methods have moved from research promise toward industrial deployment. The review then examines the data-related, model-related, regulatory, industry, and ethical challenges still limiting broader adoption, including proprietary data scarcity, black-box interpretability, and a regulatory landscape only beginning to formalize AI-specific validation requirements through the FDA’s 2025 draft guidance and the FDA-EMA’s January 2026 joint guiding principles. Future directions considered include federated learning for cross-industry data sharing, explainable AI for regulatory-ready models, digital twins for end-to-end manufacturing, and AI-guided 3D printing for personalized dosage forms. Rather than replacing the formulation scientist, AI/ML is reshaping that role, and this review concludes that closing the remaining gap depends less on further technical advances than on coordinated progress among academia, industry, and regulators.

papers.title: Machine Learning-Based Fault Classification for Intelligent Condition Monitoring in Industrial Production Systems
papers.abstract: Industrial production systems require intelligent maintenance solutions to minimize unplanned downtime, improve reliability, and support data-driven decision making. This study presents a machine learning framework for condition monitoring and fault classification in industrial production systems. The framework is evaluated using an AI4I-derived synthetic dataset comprising 10,000 production events characterized by operational sensor measurements and machine failure indicators. An exploratory analysis is first conducted to examine data distributions, failure patterns, and relationships among operational variables. Subsequently, four classification models (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting, and a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) neural network) are developed and comparatively evaluated. The results show that nonlinear models significantly outperform the Logistic Regression baseline, with Random Forest, Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting, and MLP achieving very high classification performance. The findings suggest that interactions among operational variables contribute substantially to the fault classification task and are more effectively captured by nonlinear learning approaches than by linear models using the original feature set. Overall, the study provides a benchmark-style comparative evaluation of representative machine learning classifiers for fault classification on an AI4I-derived synthetic dataset. papers.title: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Electrical Secondary Circuits Using Multi-Feature Fusion Deep Learning
papers.venue: Journal of Computing and Electronic Information Management
papers.abstract: To address the complex fault characteristics of electrical secondary circuits and the limited diagnostic capability of single-source information, this study proposes an intelligent fault diagnosis method based on multi-feature fusion deep learning. Current and voltage waveforms, statistical parameters, protection operations, circuit-breaker positions, and alarm states are jointly modeled. A multi-scale one-dimensional convolutional neural network extracts local transient patterns, a Transformer encoder captures long-range temporal dependencies, and an attention mechanism adaptively fuses the resulting representations. On an eight-class dataset containing 9600 samples, the proposed model achieves an Accuracy of 97.43%, an F1-score of 97.35%, and an AUC of 99.41%, outperforming representative machine learning and deep learning baselines. Ablation and noise tests further demonstrate the contributions of the feature branches and the robustness of the fusion strategy. The method provides a practical basis for intelligent maintenance and online condition monitoring of electrical secondary circuits.

papers.title: Predictive Vehicle Maintenance Using Machine Learning: Developing a Data-Driven Framework for Predicting Component Failure and Optimizing Maintenance Intervals in Modern Automobiles
papers.venue: International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR)
papers.abstract: Most vehicles on Indian roads are still maintained in one of two ways: they are repaired after something breaks, or they are serviced at fixed intervals that take no account of how the vehicle has actually been driven. Both approaches waste money, the first through breakdowns and downtime and the second through parts replaced long before the end of their useful life. This study develops and evaluates a data-driven framework that uses machine learning to predict component failure in advance and to set maintenance intervals according to the real condition of each vehicle. Telemetry from on-board diagnostic (OBD-II) loggers, GPS units and eighteen months of workshop records were collected from 320 commercial vehicles operated by three fleets in Punjab, covering taxis, delivery vans and school buses. Over the study period the fleet recorded 1,146 unplanned failure events, with the battery, brake system and tyres together accounting for 58% of them. Five models were trained to predict whether a component would fail within the next 30 days. Gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost) achieved the best overall result, with an F1-score of 0.82 and an area under the ROC curve of 0.93, against 0.59 and 0.78 for a logistic regression baseline, while a long short-term memory (LSTM) network gave the longest median warning time of 21 days. Remaining-useful-life estimates were most accurate for gradual-wear components such as brake pads and batteries and least accurate for suspension parts. When the model was used to schedule servicing in a cost simulation, unplanned breakdowns fell by 56% and total annual maintenance cost per vehicle fell by 41% compared with a conventional fixed-interval schedule. The findings suggest that the real value of predictive maintenance lies not only in preventing failures but in allowing each component to be used for more of its safe working life.

papers.title: Fatigue Analysis with Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
papers.abstract: This chapter explores the application of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) in fatigue analysis and reliability assessment. It highlights how AI/ML techniques can enhance various aspects of fatigue research, including data analysis, life prediction, crack detection, and surrogate modeling. Unlike many engineering applications, fatigue reliability is characterized by limited data availability and high uncertainty, posing unique challenges for data-driven methods. To address this, the chapter introduces physics-guided and uncertainty-aware ML frameworks that integrate domain knowledge with data-driven models. Neural networks (NNs), including deep learning architectures, are discussed for tasks such as S-N curve prediction, crack growth modeling, and the modeling of manufacturing processes and microstructures. The chapter also emphasizes the importance of incorporating uncertainty into AI models to ensure robust and reliable predictions. Hybrid approaches that combine physics-based models with ML are presented as a promising direction for future research. The chapter concludes by presenting a neural optimization approach for advanced fatigue design using AI/ML. Overall, this chapter provides a forward-looking perspective on how AI/ML can transform fatigue reliability analysis in the era of data-driven engineering.

raw_metadata.title_zh: 人工智能与机器学习在疲劳分析中的应用

article.lead: 疲劳分析中的人工智能，如何面对数据有限、预测不确定性高的现实？本章围绕物理知识与机器学习的结合，讨论寿命预测、裂纹建模和疲劳设计，为理解数据驱动方法的适用边界提供线索。

sections.title: 疲劳可靠性的难点：数据少，不确定性高
paragraphs: 人工智能与机器学习可用于疲劳研究中的数据分析、寿命预测、裂纹检测和代理建模。但摘要特别指出，与许多工程应用不同，疲劳可靠性面临数据可用性有限和不确定性较高的挑战，这也构成了数据驱动方法需要回应的核心问题。
本章以这些挑战为出发点，讨论如何将领域知识纳入学习模型。其关注点不仅是预测任务本身，也包括预测能否具备稳健性与可靠性；本文解读仅依据所提供的完整摘要。

sections.title: 将物理引导与不确定性感知纳入学习框架
paragraphs: 摘要介绍了物理引导和不确定性感知的机器学习框架，明确的方法关系是把领域知识与数据驱动模型相结合。同时，章节强调将不确定性纳入人工智能模型的重要性，但摘要没有说明具体的融合机制或不确定性处理算法。
在模型与任务层面，章节讨论神经网络及深度学习架构在 S-N 曲线预测、裂纹扩展建模，以及制造过程和微观组织建模中的应用。章节末尾还介绍了一种面向先进疲劳设计的神经优化方法，摘要未展开其实现细节。

sections.title: 摘要提供了方法方向，未报告量化性能
paragraphs: 摘要传达的主要认识是：物理模型与机器学习相结合，是疲劳可靠性研究值得关注的方向；不确定性也应进入模型考虑范围。不过，这些表述属于章节强调的观点与前景判断，而不是摘要中已经通过量化比较证明的性能优势。
摘要没有给出预测误差、可靠性指标或优化收益，因此不能据此断言某种网络优于传统方法，也不能把所列应用场景理解为均已完成验证。

sections.title: 样本、比较与验证范围仍需查阅正文
paragraphs: 当前摘要无法判断所涉数据的样本规模、材料种类、载荷条件和数据划分，也无法确认比较基线、验证方式及跨场景适用范围。摘要未报告这些信息，不等于章节没有讨论或开展相应工作。
对于物理约束如何进入模型、不确定性如何表征，以及神经优化采用什么目标与约束，摘要同样不足以支持具体判断。因此，目前更适合把本章作为方法阅读入口，而非直接采用其工程效果结论。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注融合机制，而不只关注网络名称
paragraphs: 阅读启发：进一步阅读时，可重点追问领域知识如何参与学习，以及模型输出如何表达不确定性。对于疲劳可靠性与设计优化的读者，还可关注寿命预测和神经优化之间是否建立了明确联系；这些是由摘要引出的阅读问题，并非当前资料已经回答的结论。

papers.title: TopoMamba: A Load-Support Relation-Guided Multi-Directional State-Space Model for Topology Optimization
papers.abstract: Deep learning has emerged as an efficient alternative for predicting high-performance material distributions in topology optimization. Existing methods struggle to accurately capture load-transfer information, limiting out-of-distribution generalization, while their model architectures often incur high computational costs. To address these challenges, this paper proposes TopoMamba, a topology prediction framework incorporating a load-support relation-guided multi-directional state-space model. Coupling physical fields with load-support relations enables more effective modeling of mechanical dependencies. A load-support relation-guided spatially adaptive fusion mechanism dynamically adjusts multi-directional scan features according to spatial conditions. Mamba is coupled with the solid isotropic material with penalty method to enhance structural mechanical performance while maintaining computational efficiency. Results on two-dimensional topology optimization benchmarks demonstrate that TopoMamba achieves superior topology prediction accuracy, out-of-distribution generalization, and computational efficiency over state-of-the-art models. The proposed load-support physics-guided framework enables efficient optimization of more complex structural systems.

papers.title: Rational design of anticancer metallodrugs.
papers.abstract: Despite the undeniable clinical success of platinum-based antineoplastic agents, their rational design remains hindered by the inherent difficulties in capturing the quantum chemical electronic nature of their three-dimensional coordination geometries and variable oxidation states of transition metal complexes. To address this fundamental limitation, we introduce a machine learning framework based on density functional theory descriptors to discriminate between drug and non-drug metallocomplexes. A curated dataset of platinum complexes was subjected to conformational sampling and density functional theory geometry optimization. Unsupervised learning via principal component analysis and K-means clustering initially demonstrated that essential electronic parameters naturally segregate metallodrugs from non-drug metallocomplexes. Subsequently, a supervised Random Forest classifier reliably distinguished metallodrugs from structurally similar non-drug metallocomplexes. Crucially, global SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis revealed that local electron density properties, which strictly govern the established mechanisms of intracellular aquation and DNA binding, are the primary drivers of model predictions. The projection of an external test set of active ChEMBL platinum compounds successfully validated the established chemical space, demonstrating the model's ability to generalize to unseen data. This explainable predictive pipeline bridges a major gap in inorganic drug discovery, offering a robust, mechanistic tool for the rational generative design of next-generation metallodrugs.

papers.title: Machine Learning–Assisted Distributed Acoustic Sensing for Microreactors
papers.abstract: This report describes an end-to-end pipeline for monitoring and classifying acoustic events in a microreactor(MR) using distributed acoustic sensing (DAS). The objective of this pipeline is to realize autonomous supervision of MRs to reduce their operational footprint. MRs promise modular, compact nuclear power, but their economic viability depends on minimizing operation and maintenance costs through remote, autonomous monitoring. To address this limitation, we investigated how optical fiber–based remote sensing could be used to support compact monitoring systems for energy facilities. Distributed optical fiber sensing, and DAS in particular, is well suited to this role because silica optical fibers are immune to electromagnetic noise, are tolerant to radiation and high temperatures, and are chemically inert. In this work, we establish the feasibility of a novel application of established machine learning (ML) event classification models and statistical anomaly detection algorithms to DAS-derived vibroacoustic data for industrial system health monitoring. We developed an end-to-end classification pipeline built on the You Only Look Once (YOLO) object recognition model and evaluated cross-source transfer between microphonic- and DAS-sourced data. The raw strain rate data were processed using an anomaly detection algorithm, which leveraged a modified푧-score using the median absolute deviation (MAD) metric. A commercial DAS system was used to collect acoustic data at the Spallation Neutron Source (SNS) at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The model trained on DAS data was effective in classifying unseen DAS data, cross-source classification was inaccurate, and fine-tuning source-derived weights with DAS spectrograms recovered strong DAS classification. Multiple anomaly detection or “trigger” approaches were explored, including a time-amplitude root mean square (RMS) trigger and a frequency-based detector. The RMS-based detector detects stationary events but fails under persistent low-frequency noise interference, and the frequency-based anomaly detector is robust to the elevated background noise. Deployment at SNS demonstrated full operation in a nuclear environment, validating the approach end to end as a proof of concept for MR monitoring and validating DAS hardware as viable for collecting vibroacoustic data for the detection and classification of MR operation noise. Dedicated DAS-derived datasets are required to achieve reliable accuracy. For future work, investigating advanced signal processing to bridge existing acoustic datasets to DAS data is a promising direction worth pursuing.

papers.title: Audited leave-one-material-out benchmark of machine-learning models for multiaxial fatigue life prediction: code, predictions and uncertainty intervals
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.abstract: Code, per-test predictions and uncertainty intervals supporting the manuscript "Multiaxial fatigue life prediction for untested alloys: a leave-one-material-out machine-learning benchmark". The release contains the audited mapping of 40 nominal alloy grades onto 41 material-condition domains, the 12 physically inconsistent records identified by the audit, the full analysis pipeline, the per-test leave-one-material-out (LOMO) and random-split predictions for every model, the per-domain conformal coverage, the individual seed scores and the network hyperparameters. The underlying fatigue measurements are those of Chen et al. (doi:10.24435/materialscloud:ad-xk) and are not redistributed here. code/00_build_dataset.py regenerates the modelling tables from that download, and SOURCE_CHECKSUMS.sha256 lists the SHA-256 of all 1170 source files so users can confirm they hold the identical version.
papers.summary: 这是一项支持未测试合金多轴疲劳寿命预测研究的数据与代码发布，当前仅作摘要级解读。[摘要]资料提供材料域映射审计、逐试验预测、逐域保形覆盖率及复现配置，并同时包含留一材料与随机划分结果。解读：其阅读价值在于考察跨材料泛化的评估方式和结果可追溯性，而非已有证据证明某种模型更优。摘要未报告预测误差、覆盖率数值或模型排名，原始疲劳测量数据需另行获取。

deep_read.problem: 研究针对未测试合金的多轴疲劳寿命预测，摘要中的“untested alloys”明确了应用对象。[摘要]解读：关键问题是模型能否从已有材料推广到未参与训练的材料，而不只是预测同一数据集合中的留出样本。当前资料未说明载荷范围、输入变量和寿命定义。
deep_read.method: 发布内容同时包括留一材料与随机划分的逐试验预测，并提供逐域保形覆盖率、种子评分和网络超参数。[摘要]原文以“LOMO”标识留一材料设置。解读：这些输出支持检查不同划分方式下的表现差异，但摘要未给出模型清单、训练流程或区间构造细节。
deep_read.innovation: 资料的明确特色是把材料映射审计与预测结果、代码和配置共同发布，原文称映射为“audited mapping”。[摘要]解读：这种组织方式有助于追查材料域定义及复现过程，但不能据此确认方法原创性；摘要没有提供与既有基准的比较或新算法说明。
deep_read.findings: 摘要报告将40个名义合金牌号映射为41个材料条件域，并标出审计发现的12条物理不一致记录，原文称其为“physically inconsistent records”。[摘要]这些是可确认的数据审计信息，不是模型性能结论；资料没有报告误差、覆盖率或模型排名。
deep_read.limitations: 当前仅有摘要，缺少模型表现及其统计比较，无法判断跨材料预测是否达到工程可用水平。[摘要]原文说明疲劳测量数据“are not redistributed here”，因此发布包本身不含这些原始测量。资料也未说明异常记录如何处理，不能把这些缺失推定为全文缺陷。
deep_read.connection: 与疲劳可靠性方向的联系直接体现在寿命预测和“uncertainty intervals”。[摘要]解读：逐材料域覆盖率可为讨论预测区间在不同材料上的适用性提供入口；结构设计或智能运维可关注其迁移验证思路，但摘要未展示安全系数、在线监测或维护决策应用。
deep_read.next_steps: 建议先获取所指原始数据，以发布的校验信息确认版本，再复现材料域划分及两类验证结果。[摘要]原文提到“1170 source files”的校验。建议重点核对异常记录处置、逐域误差及覆盖率差异；这是后续研究安排，并非作者已验证的结论。

sections.title: 未测试合金预测，需要怎样的评估依据？
paragraphs: 本次摘要介绍的是一份支撑研究稿件的代码与结果资源发布，而不是完整的研究结果摘要。其对应主题是利用机器学习预测未测试合金的多轴疲劳寿命，并以留一材料法（LOMO）构建评估基准。
资源同时提供各模型的LOMO与随机划分逐试验预测。这为进一步核对不同划分方式下的表现提供了材料，但摘要并未报告两者的性能差异，不能据此认定某种模型已经具备更强的跨材料预测能力。

sections.title: 从原始测量重建建模表，并核对数据版本
paragraphs: 底层疲劳测量来自Chen等人的数据，本次发布不重新分发这些测量。摘要说明，提供的构建脚本能够从下载的原始数据重新生成建模表；同时，校验清单列出全部1170个源文件的SHA-256，供使用者确认数据版本一致。这里的文件数不能视为独立试验样本数。

sections.title: 已公开审计发现，但未给出模型胜负
paragraphs: 摘要明确报告，审计后的映射将40个名义合金牌号对应到41个材料—条件域，并识别出12条物理上不一致的记录。这提示阅读时应区分合金牌号与材料—条件域，不能将二者直接等同。
发布内容还包括完整分析流程、逐试验预测、不确定性区间、各域的保形覆盖率、各随机种子的得分及网络超参数。**公开了覆盖率，不等于已经证明覆盖充分**：摘要没有给出覆盖率数值、预测误差或模型排名。

sections.title: 哪些预测与验证结论仍无法判断？
paragraphs: 仅凭摘要，无法判断独立试验总数、各域样本分布、模型具体构成、训练与调参细节，以及物理不一致记录的判定标准和处理方式。也无法确认不确定性区间的具体构造与校准设置，或是否开展了外部验证；这些属于当前资料未交代的信息，而不是论文没有开展相关工作的证据。

sections.title: 阅读启发：先核对评估口径，再讨论可靠性
paragraphs: 阅读启发：面向结构疲劳与可靠性应用，可优先追问材料—条件域如何定义、LOMO与随机划分的预测表现是否一致，以及各域覆盖率是否存在差异。这份资源为继续核对这些问题提供了入口，但当前摘要不足以支持工程可靠性提升或实际部署有效性的结论。

papers.title: Machine Learning Applications in Aeronautics: Real-Time Noise Visualization and Structural Optimization for Adaptive Wing Designs
papers.abstract: Atmospheric turbulence remains one of the leading contributors to loss of control in small fixed-wing aircraft, and conventional fixed-geometry wings respond to disturbances only after a measurable attitude error has already developed. This paper presents an embedded, machine-learning-based feedback system that visualizes roll, pitch, and yaw disturbances in real time using Python and adjusts elevator and rudder deflection to accelerate recovery. Seven wing configurations, high, mid, low, dihedral, anhedral, gull, and inverted gull, were fabricated from balsa wood and styrofoam and evaluated on an instrumented test stand under repeatable disturbance conditions. A small feed-forward neural network was trained on logged roll, pitch, and yaw error signals to predict corrective elevator and rudder angles, and its output was compared against an uncorrected baseline and against a simple embedded proportional controller. Across 12 trials per configuration, the high wing produced the shortest mean recovery time in all three axes (roll: 1.1 s, pitch: 1.3 s, yaw: 1.0 s) and the highest mean lift coefficient (1.28), while the anhedral wing was consistently the slowest to recover. The trained network reduced the residual mean squared error of the predicted control surface angles by 88 percent after 40 training epochs, averaged across all seven configurations, and five-fold cross-validation confirmed that this improvement generalized rather than overfitting to a single flight condition. These results suggest that pairing a self-stabilizing high-wing geometry with a lightweight, real-time learning controller can materially shorten the window in which an aircraft is vulnerable to a turbulence-induced upset, with direct implications for small unmanned aircraft safety.

papers.title: Research on bearing fault diagnosis integrating deep learning and knowledge graphs
papers.venue: Sixth International Conference on Testing Technology and Automation Engineering (TTAE 2026)
papers.abstract: To overcome the problems of scattered knowledge in traditional fault diagnosis, difficulty in identifying non-stationary signals, and poor interpretability of results, an intelligent diagnosis method integrating deep learning and a knowledge graph is proposed. This paper designs a VMD Transformer BiGRU model, combines mechanism knowledge with vibration signals, and improves fault recognition ability under complex working conditions through multi-scale decomposition and bidirectional temporal feature modeling. A multi-level bearing fault knowledge graph is constructed based on classification results and mechanism rules, and the KG-BERT-RGCN dual channel model is used to achieve semantic and structural joint modeling, breaking through traditional completion dependencies. Finally, an intelligent decision support system is built. The experiment shows that this method achieves a diagnostic F1 score of 95.59% and outperforms mainstream methods in link prediction performance.
papers.summary: 本文面向轴承故障诊断中的知识分散、非平稳信号识别困难及结果可解释性不足，提出深度学习与知识图谱融合方法。作者以VMD Transformer BiGRU处理振动信号，结合机理规则构建多层级故障图谱，再以KG-BERT-RGCN联合建模语义和结构。摘要报告诊断“F1 score of 95.59%”，并称链接预测优于主流方法。[摘要]解读：该研究贴近智能运维，但当前仅有摘要，尚不足以核验性能优势与实际解释效果。

papers.title: Polymorph-Independent Resistance to Generative Protein Design Across Five Tau Fibril Folds: A Cross-Tauopathy Benchmark
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative protein-binder-design tools such as diffusion-based backbone generators have recently been benchmarked against amyloid fibril targets, where success was found to depend on the specific structural polymorph rather than the disease of origin: some fibril folds are tractable, others uniformly resistant. Whether this polymorph-dependence generalizes to tau, the aggregating protein in Alzheimer's disease and a family of non-Alzheimer's tauopathies, is untested. We benchmarked RFdiffusion3 with mandatory ProteinMPNN sequence redesign against five distinct cryo-EM tau fibril folds spanning five tauopathies: Alzheimer's disease (paired helical filament), chronic traumatic encephalopathy, Pick's disease, corticobasal degeneration, and progressive supranuclear palsy, scoring all candidates through a common AlphaFold2-Multimer oracle. In contrast to the polymorph-dependent pattern reported for AL amyloidosis and alpha-synuclein, all five tau folds proved resistant to binder design (best interface predicted template modeling score, i_pTM, 0.116-0.401 across folds), with even the most tractable fold (progressive supranuclear palsy) falling short of the tractable range reported for other amyloid classes. Unlike those classes, where binder beta-sheet-forming amino acid propensity correlated strongly with predicted binding success, no such relationship was detected for tau (Pearson r=-0.19, p=0.50; n=15 designs), and the highest-scoring tau design is an alpha-helical bundle rather than a beta-sheet, suggesting a mechanistically distinct interaction mode. This is, to our knowledge, the first application of a modern diffusion-based generative design tool to tau fibrils, and the first evidence that resistance to generative binder design is not a universal property of amyloid geometry but varies by protein family independent of structural polymorph within that family.
papers.summary: 本研究检验生成式结合体设计在Tau纤维上的表现是否依赖结构多态性。作者对五种疾病相关折叠使用RFdiffusion3生成设计、ProteinMPNN重设计序列，并统一采用AlphaFold2-Multimer评分。五种折叠的最佳i_pTM均较低，且未检出β折叠形成倾向与预测结合成功的相关性。[摘要]解读：研究提供了生成设计的失败边界线索，但计算评分不能直接证明真实结合失败；本解读仅依据摘要。

papers.title: Polymorph-Dependent Success of Generative Protein Design Against Amyloid Fibrils: A Cross-Method Benchmark Including AL Amyloidosis
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative protein design tools such as diffusion-based backbone generators and AlphaFold2-hallucination pipelines have been validated almost exclusively on globular receptor and signaling-protein targets. Whether these methods generalize to amyloid fibrils - flat, pocket-less, cross-beta surfaces that are structurally unlike any benchmark target used to date - is unknown. We benchmarked three generative design tools (RFdiffusion3, BindCraft, and BindEnergyCraft) for their ability to design binders against eight cryo-EM fibril structures spanning three amyloid diseases: AL (immunoglobulin light-chain) amyloidosis, Parkinson's disease (alpha-synuclein), and Alzheimer's disease (amyloid-beta). AL amyloid has not previously been attempted with any of these tools. Using a common AlphaFold2-Multimer scoring oracle and a mandatory ProteinMPNN sequence-redesign step for diffusion-generated backbones, we found that design success is polymorph-dependent rather than disease-dependent: amyloid-beta fibrils resisted all three methods (interface predicted template modeling score, i_pTM, 0.09-0.15 across both polymorphs tested, and zero accepted designs across 83 combined AF2-hallucination trajectories), alpha-synuclein was largely tractable (three of four polymorphs reaching i_pTM >= 0.70), and AL amyloid split evenly between the two extremes (i_pTM 0.235 for one polymorph, 0.585 for another). Diffusion-based backbone generation (RFdiffusion3) produced confident designs on several targets where AF2-hallucination-based methods (BindCraft, BindEnergyCraft) produced none. Across all RFdiffusion3 designs, binder beta-sheet-forming amino acid propensity correlated strongly with predicted interface confidence (Pearson r = 0.80, p < 0.001; n = 24), suggesting a compositional basis for engaging the fibrils' cross-beta surface. We additionally document a hardware-access barrier: a fourth candidate tool, ESMFold2, could not be run at all on our compute infrastructure (three NVIDIA TITAN RTX GPUs) because its bfloat16 Triton kernels require Ampere-generation (compute capability >= 8.0) hardware, excluding Turing-generation GPUs entirely. This is, to our knowledge, the first computational feasibility assessment of generative binder design against AL amyloid, and the first systematic comparison of these tools on any amyloid fibril target.
papers.summary: 生成式蛋白质设计能否从球状靶标推广到平坦、无口袋的淀粉样纤维？本文以三类疾病的八种纤维结构比较三种设计工具，并统一预测评分流程。摘要报告，设计表现更依赖纤维多态结构，而非疾病类别；扩散方法在部分靶标上优于基于幻觉的方法。[摘要] 解读：研究值得作为生成式设计跨结构泛化的计算案例阅读，但预测置信度不能等同于真实结合效果，本解读不涉及全文。

papers.title: MACHINE LEARNING FOR CELLULOSE MEMBRANES: A REPRESENTATION–MODEL–TASK FRAMEWORK FOR SMALL-DATA REGIMES
papers.abstract: Cellulose membranes are a small-data problem with a chemically ambiguous object. A polymorphic matrix, three chemically inequivalent hydroxyls at C2, C3 and C6, and a two-stage fabrication route make representation — not model architecture — the binding constraint on machine learning in this field, and this is why the toolkit that succeeded for gas-separation polymers and thin-film-composite membranes does not transfer to cellulose unchanged. This review organises the methodology around that claim. It first sets out why cellulose membranes remain of interest and where they fail, then shows that the existing computational treatment of cellulose is stratified into layers — first-principles, atomistic, coarse-grained, pore-scale, phenomenological, process-level — that do not connect, so that no chain of models runs from a synthesis recipe to a measured permeance. That specific structural gap, rather than the absence of cellulose studies in the machine-learning literature, is the argument for a data-driven approach. The representation–model–task framework is then executed task by task across property prediction, synthesis optimisation with Bayesian optimisation, inverse design, microstructural analysis and fouling forecasting, with four mandatory decisions — representation, model, task, validation — made explicit for each, and interpretability treated as a validation instrument whose attributions are falsifiable by synthesis. Cellulose/iron-oxide composites for oil–water separation serve as a running example throughout. Data resources are assessed for cellulose coverage rather than catalogued; methodological pitfalls are given cellulose-specific manifestations and mitigations; and under-explored niches are classified by operational criteria under a stated, repeatable search protocol.

papers.title: Vibration fatigue analysis in mechanical structures using AI: Trends, challenges, and future opportunities
papers.abstract: During their service life, mechanical equipment used in fields such as offshore engineering is subjected to complex vibration loads induced by wind and waves, leading to the accumulation of fatigue damage and posing a serious threat to equipment safety. Therefore, conducting vibration fatigue damage analysis is of practical importance for ensuring equipment safety. In recent years, with the advancement of AI, new solutions have emerged for damage analysis, creating an urgent need to systematically review existing methodology. This paper reviews recent research progress across four dimensions. Firstly, it discusses the mechanical structures subject to vibration damage analysis. Subsequently, it summarises research on damage assessment, damage detection, service life prediction and reliability analysis from the perspectives of both traditional methods and machine learning approaches. Finally, it analyses the transition from traditional methods towards AI-driven approaches, along with the challenges faced, and identifies potential directions for future research. This review aims to provide researchers in the field of vibration fatigue analysis with a systematic methodological reference, highlighting the potential of AI to drive the evolution of traditional methods towards intelligent analysis. It seeks to support the development of vibration fatigue damage analysis methods in fields such as marine engineering.

article.lead: 风浪引起的复杂振动会让海工装备持续积累疲劳损伤，威胁服役安全。这篇综述围绕传统方法与机器学习，梳理振动疲劳分析的研究进展，阅读价值在于理解人工智能正在介入哪些分析任务，以及哪些能力仍需进一步核实。

sections.title: 从风浪振动到疲劳损伤：装备安全的分析需求
paragraphs: 机械装备在服役期间受到复杂振动载荷，疲劳损伤可能随之累积。摘要以海洋工程等领域为背景，将振动疲劳损伤分析与装备安全直接联系起来，说明这一问题具有明确的工程意义。
随着人工智能的发展，损伤分析出现了新的解决思路。本文关注的并非某个模型能否单独解决问题，而是如何系统梳理已有方法，理解传统分析向人工智能驱动分析转变的研究脉络。

sections.title: 围绕分析对象与任务，梳理传统方法和机器学习
paragraphs: 这是一篇研究进展综述，而非摘要中报告了新模型实验的研究。作者首先讨论开展振动损伤分析的机械结构，随后从传统方法与机器学习两个视角，归纳损伤评估、损伤检测、服役寿命预测和可靠性分析方面的研究。
在此基础上，综述进一步讨论向人工智能驱动方法转变的过程、面临的挑战及潜在研究方向。摘要没有交代文献检索、筛选或质量评价的具体程序，因此不能仅凭这些介绍认定其采用了严格的系统综述流程。

sections.title: 摘要呈现的是方法版图，而非性能优劣结论
paragraphs: 摘要报告的主要成果是对相关研究的组织与梳理：将机械结构、不同损伤分析任务，以及传统方法向人工智能方法的转变纳入讨论。它强调人工智能推动振动疲劳分析走向智能化的潜力，并以提供系统的方法参考为目标。
需要区分的是，支持海洋工程等领域的方法发展属于综述的预期用途。摘要没有给出具体算法的精度、效率或可靠性提升，也没有报告哪类机器学习方法优于传统方法，因而不能据此得出替代关系或工程应用成效的结论。

sections.title: 样本、比较条件与验证范围仍需查阅正文
paragraphs: 当前解读仅依据完整摘要。摘要未报告纳入文献的规模、涉及的数据样本、具体结构类型与载荷条件，也未展开方法比较的评价指标及验证范围。因此，尚不能判断综述结论对不同装备和服役场景的适用程度；这些是摘要无法回答的问题，不代表论文没有讨论。

sections.title: 阅读启发：按任务核对人工智能的实际作用
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对关注智能运维与疲劳可靠性的读者，可沿损伤检测、损伤评估、寿命预测和可靠性分析分别阅读，核对人工智能在各类任务中承担什么作用、与传统方法如何衔接。进一步值得关注的是，正文如何界定转型中的挑战，以及支撑潜在应用的证据覆盖了哪些条件，而不是预先假定人工智能已经带来普遍改进。

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Multi-Modal Deep Learning Framework for Stochastic Prediction and Reliability Assessment of Human-Induced Vibrations in Lightweight and Composite Floor Systems
papers.abstract: - Human-induced vibrations in lightweight and composite floor systems pose important serviceability concerns because these structures typically have lower stiffness, reduced mass, and higher sensitivity to dynamic loading. Conventional deterministic design methods often overlook the natural variability and short-term amplification effects caused by walking and other intermittent human activities. This study presents a physics-guided, multi-modal data-driven framework for predicting vibration responses and assessing structural reliability under human-induced loading conditions. Monitoring conducted over a 1000-second period shows bounded but dynamically fluctuating acceleration responses ranging between 9.5 m/s² and 10.2 m/s², concentrated around gravitational acceleration. Statistical evaluation indicates an approximately Gaussian distribution with minimal skewness, suggesting stable damping behavior and consistent stiffness properties. Frequency-domain analysis highlights dominant low-frequency components without noticeable resonance amplification within the typical walking frequency range of 1 – 4 Hz. Rolling mean trends reveal negligible long-term drift, confirming stable structural performance. The framework combines acceleration, strain, and environmental measurements to improve predictive capability and reliability evaluation. Correlation analysis shows that strain measurements strengthen response prediction, while temperature has a comparatively minor effect. Reliability assessment based on a probabilistic threshold model (μ + 2σ) identifies very few exceedance events, indicating a high reliability level and compliance with serviceability requirements. By integrating probabilistic modeling with physics-based structural constraints, the approach enables more accurate forecasting of vibration behavior and real-time reliability assessment. Overall, the results demonstrate improved prediction performance and provide a practical methodology for monitoring and evaluating serviceability in modern lightweight and composite floor systems.

papers.title: Gaussian process surrogate modeling for efficient controller tuning and fatigue load prediction of the helix wake-mixing method
papers.abstract: Abstract. Wind farms experience reduced power production and elevated structural loading due to wake interactions. Wake-mixing control techniques, which dynamically excite upstream turbine wakes to accelerate recovery, have demonstrated promising improvements in downstream power production but at the expense of increased fatigue loading. Identifying the optimal control settings and quantifying the resulting load implications remain challenging because these methods require high-fidelity simulations that capture both the dynamic actuation and the resulting turbulence. Moreover, existing load surrogate models do not incorporate wake-mixing control, largely because conventional engineering wake models are unable to reproduce periodic wake excitation. This study presents two complementary advances to improve the design of wake-mixing strategies using a limited number of large-eddy simulations (LES) and Gaussian process (GP) regression. First, we develop an efficient simulation-driven framework to identify optimal frequency and amplitude parameters for wake-mixing control, yielding a clear optimal power gain of 7.5 % near a Strouhal number of 0.25 and pitch amplitudes of around 4° for a two-turbine array. Second, we present a surrogate model capable of predicting fatigue loads for wake-mixing control. Using LES-derived rotor-plane inflow fields for aeroelastic simulations, we construct a load database that encompasses various combinations of wake overlap, turbine spacing, and wind farm control settings. The result is a load surrogate model based on GP regression trained on sector-averaged inflow quantities that accurately predicts damage equivalent loads, including the effect of increased excitation in the wake. This model enables the joint evaluation of power gains and load penalties at the wind farm level, supporting a more informed design of wake-mixing control strategies.

papers.title: Integrated Assessment of Battery Degradation and Advanced Characterizations in Renewable–Hydrogen Hybrid Architectures
papers.abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are widely used in electric mobility, renewable energy integration, portable electronics, and renewable–hydrogen hybrid energy systems. Despite significant advances in battery materials and design, long-term degradation remains a major challenge that affects system reliability, efficiency, and economic viability. In renewable–hydrogen hybrid architectures, battery degradation influences not only energy storage performance but also hydrogen production stability, electrolyzer operation, fuel cell utilization, and overall system efficiency. Major degradation mechanisms include solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) growth, electrolyte decomposition, lithium inventory loss, transition-metal dissolution, particle cracking, and structural phase transformations. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of degradation mechanisms affecting lithium-ion battery components and their implications for renewable–hydrogen hybrid systems. Advanced characterization techniques, including in situ and operando X-ray diffraction, electron microscopy, spectroscopy, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, cyclic voltammetry, and differential capacity analysis, are examined for their ability to reveal chemical, structural, and morphological changes during battery operation. Particular emphasis is placed on the effects of dynamic load variations, partial state-of-charge cycling, temperature fluctuations, and intermittent renewable energy inputs that accelerate degradation in hybrid systems. The review further discusses mitigation strategies such as surface engineering, electrolyte optimization, material doping, thermal management, intelligent energy management systems, predictive maintenance, and machine learning-based prognostics. Key challenges associated with battery–hydrogen integration, including efficiency trade-offs, component ageing, hydrogen production stability, and lifecycle costs, are critically analysed. The adaptability of hybrid systems under varying operating conditions is also explored, highlighting the importance of degradation-aware control strategies, digital twins, and real-time diagnostics. Finally, future research directions are identified, including multiscale characterization, physics-informed machine learning, techno-economic optimization, and life-synergy modelling. These approaches are essential for developing reliable, adaptive, and cost-effective renewable–hydrogen hybrid energy systems capable of supporting long-term decarbonization objectives.

papers.title: A multi-physics-informed neural network framework for dual prediction of creep residual life and damage fraction in austenitic stainless steels
papers.venue: Journal of the Brazilian Society of Mechanical Sciences and Engineering
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of creep degradation across multiple high-temperature alloy grades remains a significant challenge in structural integrity assessment. Classical empirical and mechanistic models are typically restricted to estimating total creep rupture life and are often material-specific, limiting their generalizability. This study presents a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework tailored for creep life assessment, enabling simultaneous prediction of creep residual life (CRL) and creep damage fraction (CDF) in nine grades of Austenitic Stainless Steels (AusSS). The scientific contributions are threefold. First, a unified dual-output modeling strategy is introduced to concurrently predict residual life and accumulated damage, enabling integrated failure prognosis beyond classical rupture-life models. Second, a multi-physics-informed feature engineering approach is developed by incorporating physically derived descriptors, including the Larson–Miller parameter (LMP), Monkman–Grant parameter (MGP), and stacking fault energy (SFE), thereby embedding creep mechanics directly into the learning process. Third, a physics-constrained loss formulation is implemented to enforce domain-consistent bounds (CRL > 0 and 0 ≤ CDF ≤ 1), ensuring physically admissible and reliable predictions. The framework is trained and validated on 1179 datapoints spanning diverse compositions and service conditions. The proposed PINN outperforms conventional Machine Learning (ML) and standard deep neural network models, achieving test R² values of 0.933 for CRL and 0.936 for CDF. SHAP-based analysis further confirms the dominant role of physics-informed features. The model provides a generalizable and interpretable tool for high-temperature structural health monitoring and predictive maintenance.
